title: Manager-Tech Ops Engineering
description:
At American Express, we know that with the right backing, people and businesses have the power to progress in incredible ways. Whether we’re supporting our customers’ financial confidence, advancing digital commerce, or enabling people to explore the world, our colleagues are constantly redefining what’s possible.

When you join Team Amex, you become part of a global community committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences. We provide opportunities to learn, grow, innovate, and build meaningful careers while fostering a culture of collaboration, inclusion, and integrity.

Together, we’ll lead the way in delivering innovative, secure, and reliable technology solutions that power millions of customer interactions every day.

Join #TeamAmex and let's lead the way together.
  
  
**About Enterprise Identity SRE & Application Support**

Enterprise Identity is the foundation of American Express's digital customer experience, enabling secure, seamless, and reliable authentication and authorization across our digital ecosystem.

The Enterprise Identity Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Application Support organization plays a critical role in ensuring the availability, performance, scalability, security, and operational resilience of mission-critical Identity and Access Management (IAM) platforms.

Our technology ecosystem includes customer authentication and logon services, OAuth-based authorization capabilities supporting Open Banking, customer identity systems of record such as Product Registry and Profile, and advanced authentication and verification capabilities including One Auth, AuthN+, and Verification Services.

Operating in a highly distributed, always-on environment, our teams support platforms with availability objectives of 99.99% and above. Through a global follow-the-sun support model spanning the United States and India, we deliver 24x7x365 operational coverage.

We partner closely with Product, Software Engineering, Architecture, Cybersecurity, and Delivery teams to engineer reliability into our platforms, accelerate automation, improve observability, and continuously enhance production stability.

**How Will You Make an Impact in This Role?**

* We are seeking a technically accomplished and results-driven Manager Tech Ops Engineering – Enterprise Identity SRE & Application Support to lead a team of engineers responsible for the reliability, availability, and operational excellence of critical customer identity platforms.
* This is a hands-on technical leadership position requiring strong expertise in site reliability engineering, modern application architectures, cloud-native technologies, production troubleshooting, observability, and automation.
* The successful candidate will combine deep engineering knowledge with strong people leadership to drive operational transformation, reduce production incidents, improve Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Restore/Recover (MTTR), and establish scalable, proactive, and automated reliability practices.
* You will serve as a technical leader and escalation point for complex production challenges, working across engineering and business teams to improve system resilience, eliminate recurring issues, and enable reliable delivery of new capabilities.
* Beyond managing day-to-day operations, you will help evolve traditional application support into an engineering-driven SRE organization focused on automation, proactive detection, self-healing, and continuous reliability improvement.

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

**Education & Professional Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in software engineering, site reliability engineering, production engineering, or application support for large-scale enterprise applications.
* 3+ years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing technical engineering teams.
* Demonstrated experience supporting business-critical, highly available applications in a 24x7 production environment.
Strong experience troubleshooting complex distributed applications and leading technical incident resolution.  

**Technical Engineering Expertise**

* Strong programming and scripting skills in at least one language such as Python, Java, or Ruby, with the ability to develop automation, diagnostic utilities, and operational tools.
* Hands-on experience supporting Java-based enterprise applications, including Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, and microservices architectures.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, application dependencies, HTTP/HTTPS, network fundamentals, load balancing, caching, and database connectivity.
* Experience with containerized applications and cloud-native platforms such as OpenShift, Kubernetes, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong knowledge of application troubleshooting, performance analysis, system diagnostics, and production debugging.
Experience implementing or supporting CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and release management processes.  

**Reliability, Observability & Automation**

* 5+ years of experience implementing or operating application monitoring, logging, metrics, alerting, and observability solutions.
* Hands-on experience with one or more observability platforms such as Splunk, ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, or equivalent tools.
* 3+ years of experience developing operational automation, scripting solutions, or automated remediation workflows.
* Demonstrated understanding of SRE principles, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, incident response, and toil reduction.
* Experience improving application availability, resilience, performance, and operational efficiency through engineering-driven solutions.
Strong experience in root cause analysis, production problem management, and implementation of preventive measures.  

**Leadership & Delivery**

* Demonstrated ability to lead engineers through high-priority production incidents and complex technical investigations.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working with Agile teams and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Ability to translate technical challenges and operational risks into clear recommendations and actionable improvement plans.
Experience collaborating across geographically distributed engineering and support teams.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Identity & Security Engineering**

* Experience supporting enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM), authentication, or authorization platforms.
* Understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), JSON Web Tokens (JWT), Single Sign-On (SSO), and related identity protocols.
* Familiarity with API security, token lifecycle management, session management, and authentication workflows.
Experience supporting customer-facing identity services in financial services or other highly regulated environments.  

**Advanced SRE & Platform Engineering**

* Prior experience as a Site Reliability Engineer, Production Engineer, Software Engineer, or technical lead supporting large-scale distributed systems.
* Experience designing or improving highly available, fault-tolerant, and horizontally scalable application architectures.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes/OpenShift troubleshooting, container orchestration, and cloud-native operational practices.
* Knowledge of infrastructure as code and automation frameworks such as Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with resilience engineering techniques, including load testing, failover testing, chaos engineering, and disaster recovery validation.
Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, application performance management, and service dependency mapping.  

**AIOps & Intelligent Operations**

* Experience implementing AIOps capabilities, anomaly detection, event correlation, predictive monitoring, or intelligent incident management.
* Exposure to AI-assisted operational tooling, automated diagnostics, and self-healing architectures.
Experience developing automation frameworks or internal tools that improve engineering productivity and reduce operational toil.  

**Operational Excellence**

* Working knowledge of IT Service Management (ITSM) principles, including incident, problem, change, and release management.
* Experience with production readiness assessments, operational risk management, and non-functional requirements validation.
* Experience establishing reliability dashboards, operational scorecards, and measurable continuous improvement programs.
* Demonstrated ability to influence engineering practices and drive cross-functional technical initiatives.

  

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

  

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

description:
### **Job Title**

People Technology and AI Automation Specialist

### **Job Description**

**Title:** People Technology and AI Automation Specialist

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Workflow Automation Architecture: Design and implement end-to-end automated workflows for critical HR processes, including talent acquisition, onboarding provisioning, benefits enrolment changes, and offboarding checklists.
* System Integration: Connect disparate HR software ecosystems (such as Applicant Tracking Systems, Performance Management tools, and Learning Management Systems) with core HCM platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or BambooHR) via APIs and middleware.

Data Integrity & Compliance: Ensure all automated pipelines adhere to strict data security protocols, maintaining high accuracy and compliance with global data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).  

  

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

  

**Technical Skills**

* HR Technology: Deep familiarity with core HRIS/HCM platform data structures and employee lifecycle modules.
* Automation Tools: Advanced proficiency in low-code/no-code workflow automation platforms (e.g., Microsoft Power Automate, Copilot, Claude, Codex, Make, or Zapier).
Data & APIs: Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and Webhooks to sync data between cloud applications. Intermediate knowledge of SQL for data validation is highly preferred.  

  

**Soft Skills & Workplace Attributes**

* Analytical Problem Solving: Exceptional ability to deconstruct complex, manual human processes into logical, step-by-step technical business rules.
* Stakeholder Management: Strong communication skills to gather requirements from non-technical HR teams and translate them into efficient automated flows.
Understanding of End-to-End process and identify opportunity to introduce AI/Automation – thus reducing manual work and improve data quality.

title: Lead System Engineer - Google Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are seeking a **Lead System Engineer - Google Forward Deployed Engineer** to design, build, and deploy production-grade agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients, working hands-on with Gemini Enterprise, Google ADK, and the broader Google Workspace ecosystem to deliver scalable, secure, and intelligent multi-agent systems.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and deploy production-grade Multi-Agent Systems and agentic workflows using Gemini Enterprise
* Identify the need for Pro Code vs No Code design based on customer's problem statement and data sources
* Build and deploy custom agents using the ADK and Agent Platform AI Reasoning Engine, and integrate them with Gemini Enterprise
* Build native integrations across the Google Workspace Ecosystem and NotebookLM for grounded enterprise research, document automation, and conversational discovery
* Architect scalable short-term session storage, conversation state persistence, and long-term memory architectures across multi-agent interactions
* Implement end-to-end authentication and authorization perimeters for agents, GCP services, and 3rd-party SaaS integrations using IAM, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and service identities
* Enforce fine-grained ACLs, user/group permission inheritance, and data governance policies to ensure agents strictly adhere to enterprise access boundaries
* Utilize developer tooling including Agent CLI and Antigravity for local rapid prototyping, testing, emulation, distributed tracing, and RCA
* Architect HITL workflows, ensuring seamless Interrupt and Resume patterns between autonomous agents and human experts for critical decision points
* Build and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines to manage versioned agent deployments, automated testing, and continuous regression evaluations
* Implement advanced reasoning patterns such as Chain-of-Thought (CoT), ReAct, Plan-and-Solve, and Self-Reflection to enhance agent reliability
* Collaborate directly with client engineering and architecture teams to deploy, validate, and operationalize enterprise agentic AI solutions in client environments

**Requirements**

* 7-13 years of overall IT experience, including 4 to 6+ years in software development, cloud solution architecture, and AI engineering, preferably on GCP
* Proficiency in Python with production-level software engineering practices, and expertise in building multi-agent systems using Google ADK or comparable agentic frameworks
* Hands-on experience deploying and customizing Gemini Enterprise, NotebookLM, and integrating with the Google Workspace Ecosystem, including APIs, Add-ons, and Drive/Docs connectors
* Expertise in managing agent session state, short-term context caching, and durable long-term memory backends such as vector databases and relational/NoSQL session stores
* Experience with MCP Connectors to securely integrate core third-party platforms with Gemini Enterprise
* Understanding of authentication and authorization protocols across GCP and 3rd-party SaaS platforms, including IAM, OAuth 2.0, and OIDC
* Knowledge of enterprise ACLs, identity federation, permission trimming, and RBAC across heterogeneous data sources
* Proficiency in developer tooling such as Agent CLI and Antigravity for local simulation, debugging, prompt engineering, and execution graph tracing
* Proven track record of configuring and maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines for agent containerization, deployment, and test automation
* Knowledge of AI evaluation methodologies, trajectory analysis, and performing RCA on agent execution failures, tool errors, and prompt regressions
* Proven track record of designing, building, and deploying production AI agents or enterprise GenAI solutions using ADK, Vertex AI, or Gemini
* Hands-on experience in customer-facing technical delivery, solutions engineering, or FDE roles, with familiarity with enterprise Agile SDLC, sprint delivery, and stakeholder management

**Nice to have**

* Experience with inter-agent communication protocols such as MCP and A2A architectures
* Experience integrating agents with Enterprise Knowledge Graphs, structured ontologies, and hybrid vector search systems
* Experience with enterprise data security frameworks such as Sensitive Data Protection and VPC Service Controls

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
  + Health benefits
  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud,

security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon

has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of

governments and educational organizations.

The Sr. Support Engineer (I.C.) provides advanced technical support to customers using Gigamon solutions. This role troubleshoots complex networking issues across Layer 2 and Layer 3 technologies, manages escalations through resolution, and partners with internal teams to address customer concerns. The engineer also supports RMA

coordination, issue documentation, and customer satisfaction analysis. Success in this role requires strong technical depth, effective cross-functional collaboration, and a

customer-focused approach to problem resolution.

**What****you’ll****do:**
=========================

* Provide advanced technical support to assigned customers through phone and email support queues.
* Troubleshoot, reproduce, and develop workarounds for complex product and networking issues.
* Apply strong knowledge of Ethernet, TCP/IP, OSPF, Layer 2 and Layer 3 VPNs, multicast protocols, VLANs, trunks, switching, stacking, and service provider technologies.
* Troubleshoot GTP correlation issues and use network test equipment, including Spirent and IXIA.
* Manage hot escalations and drive customer issues through resolution while maintaining clear communication with all involved parties.
* Document and report the status of major issues, operational conditions, customer concerns, and resolution activities.
* Coordinate RMA processes, including equipment delivery to customers and the return of hardware from customer locations to Gigamon.
* Collaborate with Quality Assurance, Sustaining Engineering, and other internal organizations to communicate customer requirements and advocate for timely resolutions.
* Analyze and report on customer satisfaction related to Gigamon products, services, and processes
* Participate in customer support center activities and contribute to consistent, high-quality support operations.

**What****you’ve****done:**
===========================

* Earned a bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field.
* Gained at least three years of technical service or technical support experience in networking.
* Built strong working knowledge across Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking technologies.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting customer issues, reproducing problems, and developing effective workarounds.
* Managed technical escalations and coordinated complex issues across multiple internal teams.
* Worked directly with customers to resolve technical issues and improve customer satisfaction.
* Developed strong project management, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
* Demonstrated the ability to document, analyze, and report on technical issues and customer feedback.

**Who****you****are:**
======================

* A customer-focused technical professional who advocates for timely and effective resolutions.
* An empowered self-starter who works effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* A clear and confident communicator with strong verbal, written, and presentation skills in English.
* An active listener who builds productive relationships with customers and cross-functional teams.
* An organized professional who can prioritize responsibilities and meet deadlines.
* A collaborative partner who takes initiative, adapts to changing priorities, and works with limited supervision.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Web Experience Engineer
description:

We are looking for a creative, motivated, and detail-oriented Web Experience Engineer with 1–3 years of experience to join our team. The candidate will be responsible for developing modern, responsive, and interactive websites and web experiences based on client requirements, design specifications, and business objectives.

The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frontend development, along with practical experience in WordPress and website development. The candidate should also be enthusiastic about adopting AI-powered development tools to improve productivity, accelerate coding, and explore innovative ways to build better web experiences.

description:
**AI Engineer - Senior**
------------------------

**Field**

**Details**

**Location**

Abu Dhabi and Dubai, UAE

  

**Engagement Model**

Full-time

  

**Language**

Arabic, English

OCS

6 months

**Role Summary**

AI only earns trust in government when it is accurate, explainable and secure. The Senior AI Engineer leads the design, build and deployment of production-grade AI and GenAI solutions on governed, high-quality data. They own the technical architecture and quality of AI solutions end to end, turning complex use cases into reliable applications that are measurable, auditable and compliant with UAE AI and data regulation.

The role works alongside business analysts, data architects, data engineers and the Data Governance Council, and acts as the technical lead and mentor for junior AI engineers. Its job is to take AI from prototype to production at scale, using the Microsoft Azure AI ecosystem on top of the Purview-governed data foundation, and to set the engineering and responsible-AI standards the team follows.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead the end-to-end design, development and deployment of AI/ML and GenAI applications, including RAG assistants, document intelligence, classification, prediction and Arabic/English NLP use cases, from use-case shaping through to production operations.
* Architect enterprise-scale retrieval-augmented generation solutions using Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, vector indexing, hybrid retrieval and re-ranking, agentic and prompt orchestration, and grounding on curated Gold-layer data, optimising for accuracy, latency and cost.
* Define and operationalise responsible-AI controls covering explainability, bias testing, content safety, hallucination controls and human-in-the-loop review, aligned to the UAE Charter for the Development and Use of AI and Dubai's AI ethics principles, and present them to the Data Governance Council.
* Design secure, scalable APIs and integration patterns that connect AI capabilities with enterprise applications, portals and analytics, with role-based access, data masking, private networking and identity controls enforced.
* Partner with data architects and data engineers to define AI-ready data products, feature pipelines and data-quality gates, and ensure training and grounding data meets DQ and classification controls.
* Establish the evaluation framework: accuracy, relevance, latency and cost KPIs, automated regression testing, red-teaming and go/no-go release criteria applied before each release.
* Own CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, monitoring, drift detection, observability and cost management for AI workloads in production.
* Lead the application of UAE PDPL, Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR requirements to AI workloads, including threat modelling, data residency, PII handling and prompt/response logging, in coordination with security and data-protection teams.
* Act as technical lead for the AI workstream: lead and mentor junior AI engineers, run design and code reviews, set engineering standards and best practices, and support estimation, planning and delivery quality.
* Advise senior business and technology stakeholders on AI feasibility, risk, roadmap and trade-offs, and translate business needs into clear technical solutions and delivery plans.
* Produce and review model cards, solution architecture and design decisions, runbooks and audit evidence for each AI component.
* Lead capability building for Client's counterparts in AI engineering practices, tooling and responsible-AI operations so that solutions can be sustained after handover.

### **Must Have**

* AI certification.
* 8+ years in software engineering, with at least 4 years designing, building and deploying AI/ML or GenAI solutions in production, including ownership of multiple enterprise-scale deployments.
* Proven experience as a technical lead, guiding and mentoring a team of engineers and owning solution architecture and delivery quality.
* Expert-level Python skills, with deep experience in frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, PyTorch, scikit-learn or Hugging Face, and in building agentic and multi-step LLM workflows.
* Deep hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning and vector databases, including hybrid retrieval, evaluation and fine-tuning approaches.
* Strong experience designing scalable APIs and services (REST/FastAPI), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code.
* Strong command of MLOps/LLMOps, model evaluation, prompt engineering, red-teaming, observability and responsible-AI practices.
* Solid understanding of lakehouse architecture, Microsoft Fabric and governed data consumption through Purview.
* Working knowledge of UAE AI and data regulation, including the UAE AI Charter, UAE PDPL, the Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR, with experience applying it in delivery.
* Excellent English communication, documentation and stakeholder-management skills.

### **Good to Have**

* Arabic proficiency and Arabic NLP experience.
* Relevant Microsoft Azure AI or architecture certifications (for example Azure AI Engineer Associate or Azure Solutions Architect Expert).
* Experience in government or other regulated sectors.

title: Quality Inspector
description:
A **Quality Inspector** reviews raw materials, in-process components, and finished products during manufacturing to verify they comply with safety, quality, and engineering specifications.Job SummaryWe are seeking a detail-oriented and technically skilled **Quality Inspector** to safeguard product integrity on the production floor. You will serve as the final or intermediate safeguard between production and the customer, utilizing precision tools to test, measure, and document product quality while collaborating with cross-functional teams to resolve defects.Key Responsibilities & Duties

* **Inspect Materials & Products:** Check incoming raw materials, components at various assembly stages, and finished goods against design blueprints and technical specifications.
* **Use Precision Equipment:** Operate measuring tools such as calipers, micrometers, gauges, and coordinate measuring machines (CMM) to verify physical dimensions and tolerances.
* **Identify & Report Defects:** Reject non-conforming items, trigger containment procedures, and record inspection results and defect metrics in logs or enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems.
* **Collaborate with Teams:** Partner with production staff, engineers, and quality managers to troubleshoot root causes (such as via Lean Six Sigma or Ishikawa methods) and recommend real-time corrective actions.
* **Maintain Compliance:** Ensure adherence to company standards, safety guidelines, and industry frameworks (such as ISO 9000 or ISO standards).

Qualifications & Requirements

* **Education:** High school diploma or GED required; an associate degree or vocational training in a technical field is preferred.
* **Experience:** 1 to 3+ years of relevant experience in a manufacturing, production, or quality assurance environment.
* **Certifications:** Quality control or inspection certifications (such as ASQ CQI or ISO 9000 familiarity) are a strong plus.
* **Technical Skills:**
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, schematics, and blueprints.
* Proficiency with hand inspection tools and automated testing systems.
* Basic mathematics, computer literacy, and reporting software competency.
* **Soft Skills:** Strong attention to detail, analytical problem-solving, clear written/verbal communication, and physical stamina for factory floor environments.

description:
**Role description**

Data Architect Role Overview The Data Architect will define and own end-to-end data architecture for AI initiatives on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This role establishes the data models, platform patterns, governance, and operational standards needed to support ingestion, storage, transformation, serving, and retrieval. Working with business stakeholders, AI specialists, platform engineers, and data engineers, the Data Architect will translate business needs into scalable data foundations and clear architectural direction. Key Responsibilities Data architecture and modeling: Own the architecture across BigQuery, AlloyDB/PostgreSQL, Cloud Storage, and related services. Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling, including domain boundaries, partitioning, indexing, and schema evolution. Pipeline architecture: Establish reference architectures and reusable design patterns for batch and streaming pipelines using Dataflow, Cloud Composer/Airflow, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Run. AI-ready data foundations: Design data foundations for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, and hybrid search, including document ingestion, chunking, metadata, embedding pipelines, vector storage using pgvector/ScaNN, and refresh and re-indexing patterns. Large language model integration and evaluation: Define standards for integrating large language model (LLM) APIs, including Vertex AI/Gemini and other providers, into extraction, classification, summarization, and enrichment workflows. Balance quality, cost, latency, and security. Partner with quality assurance (QA) to design evaluation frameworks covering golden datasets, sampling, human review, regression testing, and ongoing measurement of accuracy, consistency, cost, and latency. Governance and data quality: Establish validation, cataloging, and lineage architecture, including tools such as Dataplex. Define standards for personally identifiable information (PII), retention, access controls, and auditability. Reliability and operations: Set service-level agreement (SLA) and service-level objective (SLO) standards, monitoring, ing, idempotency, backfills, failure handling, and incident response. Lead architectural root cause analysis and post-incident reviews. Technology strategy: Evaluate data technologies and platforms, document trade-offs, and guide build-versus-buy decisions, cost optimization, and scalability planning. Support integration with hybrid-cloud and legacy systems, including Azure-based data services where applicable. Cross-functional architecture: Partner with the AI Architect and AI Engineer to support retrieval and agent solutions through sound data design. Work with the Platform Engineer on continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), Infrastructure as Code, and environment standards for data workloads. Technical leadership: Mentor Data Engineers, conduct design and code reviews, and guide complex implementations. Translate business needs and data domains into architectural roadmaps, and produce clear architecture documentation and decision records for technical and non-technical audiences. Qualifications and Technical Expertise Experience designing end-to-end cloud data architectures, with expertise in GCP data services such as BigQuery, AlloyDB/PostgreSQL, and Cloud Storage. Strong conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling skills, including schema evolution, partitioning, indexing, and domain design. Experience defining batch and streaming pipeline patterns using Dataflow, Cloud Composer/Airflow, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Run. Experience designing data foundations for RAG, semantic and hybrid search, embedding pipelines, vector storage, and LLM-enabled workflows. Ability to define data quality, governance, lineage, security, retention, and access-control standards, alongside evaluation approaches for AI-enabled data use cases. Knowledge of data-platform reliability, monitoring, failure recovery, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code, with the ability to evaluate scalability, cost, and operational trade-offs. Ability to lead architectural decisions, mentor Data Engineers, collaborate across business and engineering teams, and communicate technical direction through clear documentation and roadmaps. Familiarity with hybrid-cloud and legacy-system integration, including Azure-based data services where applicable.

title: Lead / Senior SAP Joule & Multi-Agent Integration Engineer
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are building the next generation of enterprise AI interoperability. As an **SAP Joule & Multi-Agent Integration Engineer**, you will pioneer our agentic AI roadmap — designing, building, and securing cross-platform agent networks that connect SAP's Joule ecosystem with ServiceNow and other enterprise platforms over open agent communication protocols. You will own the full lifecycle of agent development, from BTP provisioning through production A2A orchestration.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and deploy pro-code AI agents on SAP BTP (Cloud Foundry/Kyma) using Joule Studio, LangGraph, or SAP Cloud SDK for AI — defining agent tools, orchestration logic, and backend integrations against S/4HANA OData APIs (Orders, Quotes, Contracts, Accounts) via BTP Destination Service
* Architect and implement end-to-end A2A communication between SAP Joule and the ServiceNow platform — exposing Joule agents as A2A-compliant servers via SAP Agent Gateway, authoring Agent Cards, configuring JSON-RPC endpoints, and registering External Agent Providers in ServiceNow AI Agent Studio over Google A2A protocol v0.3.0
* Design primary/secondary agent delegation patterns, async push notification flows, and timeout-resilient pipelines across SAP and non-SAP agent networks — ensuring agents reason, delegate, and recover reliably at enterprise scale
* Configure end-to-end authentication across agent boundaries using OAuth2, SAP IAS App2App trust, and BTP Cloud Identity Services — enforcing least-privilege access, token governance, and audit-ready agent call chains
* Own the full SAP BTP stack underpinning agent workloads — AI Core provisioning, SAP Build Process Automation entitlements, Cloud Foundry runtime, Destination Service, and SAP Agent Gateway configuration
* Instrument agent pipelines with structured logging, distributed tracing, and alerting so failures are caught early, root-caused quickly, and prevented systematically across multi-hop agent calls

**Requirements**

* 4+ years of hands-on SAP BTP engineering experience, including Cloud Foundry, SAP Cloud Identity Services, and Destination Service configuration
* Proven experience building and deploying custom Joule agents in Joule Studio (pro-code path) with tool definitions wired to SAP backend systems via OData or REST APIs
* Demonstrated production experience enabling Agent-to-Agent (A2A) integration between SAP Joule and ServiceNow AI Agent Studio, including Agent Card authoring, External Agent Provider registration, credential aliasing, and A2A protocol handshake validation
* Strong command of agentic AI frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent) and multi-agent orchestration patterns, including delegation, fallback, and async response handling
* Solid understanding of API security and authentication: OAuth 2.0, mutual TLS, SAP IAS trust configurations, and BTP service bindings
* Familiarity with ServiceNow platform internals — Now Assist AI Agents, Integration Hub, Flow Designer, and Connection & Credential Aliases
* Strong grasp of distributed systems design, API performance, and fault-tolerance patterns relevant to multi-agent pipelines
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex agent topology designs for both engineering and business audiences

**Nice to have**

* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) alongside A2A for tool and resource exposure across agent boundaries
* Exposure to SAP BRIM, SOM, or BTP Integration Suite (CPI) for SAP business process integration context
* Familiarity with ServiceNow Yokohama/Zurich release features for external agent interoperability
* SAP BTP or ServiceNow certifications (Certified Application Developer, Certified Implementation Specialist)
* CI/CD experience for BTP workloads using Cloud Foundry CLI, MTA deployment, or GitHub Actions pipelines

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
  + Health benefits
  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Connectivity Validation Engineer
description:
**Career Area:**

Engineering

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**JOB PURPOSE:**

For Caterpillar, Connectivity means using technology to extract data from our machines and engines and transform it into valuable recommendations and insights to help customers make better, more informed decisions and help Caterpillar make robust products with the lowest total ownership cost. Our products generate and process large amounts of data from sensors, on-board models, and control algorithms in real-time, creating real-world machine usage information to provide condition monitoring and fleet management services.

**Job Description**

Caterpillar’s **Connectivity Systems team – Cat Technology Division** is currently seeking an **Electronic Systems Verification and Validation Engineer** to support the End-to-End Connectivity Validation team.

In this role, you will provide technical leadership in defining and executing **validation strategies** for complex connected products across onboard machine/engine systems, embedded software, connectivity, and back-office systems. You will drive **Shift Left validation** by expanding the use of simulation, Software-in-the-Loop (SiL), Hardware-in-the-Loop (HiL), test automation, and other advanced validation methods to identify issues earlier in the product development lifecycle.

You will be part of a global engineering team working closely with Systems, Software, Hardware, and Product teams to define validation strategies, develop **DVP&R**, conduct release validation, automate testing, troubleshoot complex issues, and continuously advance Caterpillar’s validation capabilities.

**What You Will Do:**

The primary function of this role is to apply **engineering principles and technical leadership** to the verification and validation of embedded and connected systems that enable Caterpillar telematics products.

* Define **validation strategies and own DVP&R** based on product requirements, architecture, customer use cases, and technical risks.
* Determine appropriate **validation coverage** across SIL, HIL bench, system, machine, and End-to-End environments.
* Develop **validation plans, test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and requirements-to-test traceability**.
* Lead system integration and End-to-End validation across embedded hardware/software, connectivity, and back-office interfaces.
* Develop and expand **automated regression and continuous validation** capabilities to improve **test coverage and efficiency**.
* Analyse test results**, troubleshoot** complex system issues, and drive **root-cause analysis** and issue resolution.
* Introduce new validation approaches, **simulation capabilities, automation frameworks**, and **AI-assisted methods** to improve quality and productivity.
* Champion **Shift Left validation** using simulation, SIL, virtual environments, and automation to identify defects earlier in the development cycle.
* Influence product requirements and design to improve testability, diagnosability, reliability, and robustness.
* Provide **technical guidance and mentoring** to engineers and communicate **validation status, technical risks, and release readiness** to stakeholders.

**What You Have (Basic Requirements):**

**Education Requirement:**

* Degree or advanced degree in an accredited Engineering curriculum in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline with 9-12 years related experience.

**Technical Excellence:**

* Strong working knowledge of embedded and connected systems and the ability to provide solutions to complex technical challenges.
* Ability to define validation strategies and provide technical leadership across multiple levels of product validation.
* Ability to mentor engineers and influence technical decisions across cross-functional teams.

**Product Testing:**

* Excellent working knowledge of product testing approaches, techniques, and tools; ability to design, plan, and execute End-to-End system validation.
* Experience developing DVP&R, validation plans, test coverage, acceptance criteria, and requirements traceability.
* Experience with SiL, HiL, simulation, system integration, regression, and release validation.
* Ability to evaluate and introduce new test environments, tools, and validation methods.

**Analytical Thinking:**

* Strong knowledge of data analysis and diagnostic techniques to interpret complex test results and system behavior.
* Ability to break down complex system problems, identify potential root causes, and drive technical issues to resolution.
* Ability to use validation evidence and engineering judgement to assess product risk and readiness.
* Applies lessons learned to improve future validation coverage and prevent issue recurrence.

**Effective Communications:**

* Collaborative team player with strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Clearly communicates technical information, validation findings, risks, and recommendations across diverse teams.
* Effectively presents and reviews validation strategies, results, and technical issues with process partners and leadership.
* Provides technical guidance, constructive feedback, and coaching to other engineers.

**Top Candidates Will Have:**

* Demonstrated experience defining validation strategies and DVP&R for embedded or connected products.
* Strong experience with embedded systems, system integration, and End-to-End validation.
* Experience with connectivity technologies such as CAN/J1939, Ethernet, Cellular/4G/5G, GNSS, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and MQTT.
* Strong experience with Python scripting and automated test frameworks.
* Experience with dSPACE tools such as VEOS, ControlDesk, AutomationDesk, or equivalent SiL/HiL environments.
* Experience developing or enhancing test benches, simulators, and validation infrastructure.
* Experience with CI/CD or continuous validation practices.
* Practical experience applying AI/GenAI to engineering or validation workflows is an advantage.
* Strong ability to troubleshoot complex hardware, software, and system integration issues.

**Posting Dates:**

November 10, 2026 - November 23, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

title: Sr. Director, Security Engineering
description:
At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.

The Senior Director, Product Security & PSIRT, will lead large-enterprise product security programs across Gigamon’s hardware and software portfolio. This role will set the strategic direction for the PSIRT team, chair the PSIRT Steering Committee, and partner with VP and executive leadership to drive timely, risk-based decisions. Serving as the PSIRT technical advisor to the COO and CISO, the leader will establish consistent, repeatable practices for vulnerability research, testing, customer engagement, communications, knowledge base content, and coordinated disclosure. They will also develop Gigamon’s product red-team framework, evaluate appropriate security tools, and advise the CISO on the evolving product security tool landscape.

**What you’ll do**

* Set the strategic direction, priorities, and operating model for Gigamon’s Product Security and PSIRT programs.
* Lead and develop the PSIRT team, including mentoring junior PSIRT engineers and establishing clear expectations for performance, technical growth, and delivery.
* Chair the PSIRT Steering Committee and partner with VP and executive leadership to assess material vulnerabilities, prioritize response activities, and drive accountability.
* Serve as the PSIRT technical advisor to the COO and CISO, providing clear assessments of product security risks, response options, remediation progress, and business impact.
* Establish consistent, repeatable processes for vulnerability intake, research, testing, triage, remediation tracking, customer engagement, communications, knowledge base articles, and coordinated disclosure.
* Lead vulnerability research and testing across Gigamon’s hardware and software products, including attack-surface analysis, product behavior analysis, exploitability assessment, and validation of remediation.
* Develop a product red-team framework covering engagement models, testing methodologies, objectives, reporting standards, risk prioritization, and remediation follow-through.
* Coordinate product red-team and adversarial testing activities with internal teams and qualified external providers, as appropriate.
* Evaluate the product security and red-team tool landscape and advise the CISO on tool selection, adoption, integration, and investment priorities.
* Translate vulnerability research and adversarial testing results into practical security improvements and risk-based remediation plans.
* Guide product and engineering teams in applying secure development practices, including threat modeling, static and dynamic application security testing, fuzzing, penetration testing, and secure release processes.
* Oversee security advisories, customer notifications, frequently asked questions, remediation guidance, and other communications related to product vulnerabilities.
* Establish release security governance, including security reviews, risk acceptance, exception management, and criteria for product security readiness.
* Partner with product, engineering, threat research, detection, support, customer success, legal, and communications teams to coordinate vulnerability response and improve product security outcomes.
* Identify appropriate opportunities to use automation and artificial intelligence in vulnerability research, testing, PSIRT operations, and security communications while maintaining oversight, quality, and accountability.
* Communicate product security posture, material risks, response status, and remediation progress clearly to executive and cross-functional stakeholders.

**What you’ve done**

* Bring at least 10 years of progressive PSIRT experience, including leadership of large-enterprise product security programs.
* Led or scaled PSIRT, product security, vulnerability research, security engineering, or closely related programs across hardware, software, networking, or security products.
* Established strategic direction, operating models, priorities, and measurable delivery expectations for product security teams.
* Developed and mentored junior PSIRT engineers while building technical capability and supporting career growth.
* Led vulnerability intake, triage, research, testing, remediation tracking, customer engagement, security advisories, and coordinated disclosure.
* Developed or operated red-team, adversarial testing, penetration testing, or vulnerability research programs.
* Created frameworks, methodologies, or operating models for product red-team activities where a formal capability was not previously established.
* Evaluated security testing and product security tools and advised senior security leaders on technology selection, adoption, and investment.
* Chaired or operated an executive-level security steering committee and partnered effectively with COO, CISO, VP, and executive leadership on risk decisions.
* Served as a trusted technical advisor to senior executives on product security posture, material vulnerabilities, remediation strategies, and business risk.
* Applied secure development practices, including threat modeling, static and dynamic application security testing, fuzzing, penetration testing, and secure release governance.
* Translated complex vulnerabilities and adversarial findings into practical engineering actions, risk-based priorities, and clear executive decisions.
* Set priorities and delivered measurable results through organizational change and competing business demands.
* Worked effectively across distributed product and engineering organizations without relying solely on direct authority.
* Applied knowledge of Linux, operating-system security, embedded systems, networking, cloud platforms, or platform engineering.
* Applied automation or artificial intelligence to software security, vulnerability research, red teaming, PSIRT operations, or engineering workflows.
* Earned a bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, cybersecurity, or a related field, or demonstrated equivalent professional experience.

**Who you are**

* A strategic and technically credible product security leader who can set direction while engaging deeply with complex hardware and software security challenges.
* An experienced PSIRT operator who establishes durable processes and delivers consistent, high-quality outcomes.
* A builder who can develop practical red-team frameworks and mature emerging product security capabilities.
* A pragmatic technology strategist who evaluates tools based on effectiveness, scalability, integration, operational fit, and cost.
* A trusted technical advisor who provides clear, balanced guidance to the COO, CISO, and executive leadership.
* A decisive executive partner who can chair a steering committee, establish accountability, and drive timely action.
* A practical problem solver who helps product and engineering teams balance security, delivery, reliability, customer impact, and business requirements.
* A clear communicator who explains technical vulnerabilities, remediation priorities, response decisions, and business implications without alarmism.
* A customer-focused leader who values accurate, consistent, and actionable security communications.
* A collaborative partner who builds trust across product, engineering, threat research, detection, support, customer success, legal, communications, and executive teams.
* A people-focused leader who develops junior engineers, grows technical capability, and creates a high-performing, inclusive organization.
* An accountable operator who sets priorities, follows through on commitments, and makes sound risk-based decisions.
* A global-minded leader who works effectively across distributed teams and makes product security a shared responsibility.

title: Software Principal Engineer
description:

As a Software Principal Engineer, you will lead the end-to-end engineering of Dell networking products and solutions for data center and AI fabric environments, driving innovation in a fast-paced development environment from requirements definition and architecture through development, validation, release, and customer deployment.

You will collaborate with platform, silicon, software, validation, solutions, and customer-facing teams to deliver next-generation Dell Enterprise SONiC capabilities for the high-performance network fabrics powering the Dell AI Factory. **You will:**

* Own complex networking features end to end, from requirements and architecture through validation and delivery of production-quality Dell Enterprise SONiC software.
* Architect and deliver large-scale data center and AI fabric capabilities on Dell PowerSwitch (800GbE/1.6TbE) platforms, including RoCEv2, congestion management, adaptive routing, SRv6, and dynamic load balancing.
* Troubleshoot complex system, scalability, performance, and customer issues across the control plane, data plane, SAI, and switch ASIC layers.

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering in CSE, ECE, EEE, IT, Computer Networks, Cloud Computing, or equivalent.

Verizon is seeking a highly technical, hands-on Development Engineer to join our Data as a Service (DaaS) & Analytics team. This is an execution-focused, "hands-on with code" position. You will architect and build modern data products, leveraging the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem to design scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and serverless application architectures.

**What you’ll be doing...**

* Architecting and optimizing large-scale security data repositories within Google BigQuery, ensuring efficient partitioning, clustering, and storage tiering to support multi-terabyte analytical queries.
* Designing and implementing robust, low-latency data pipelines using GCP Dataflow services (Apache Beam) to ingest, transform, and aggregate batch and streaming data from disparate security sources into centralized data platforms.

* Developing and maintaining a standardized semantic layer using LookML (Looker Modeling Language) to ensure data consistency, security access controls, and reusability across all security domains.
* Building comprehensive business cases and data models surrounding Enterprise Security Data Analysis and Reporting to drive long-term security investments.

**What we’re looking for...**

* Proven experience architecting and developing solutions within Google Cloud Platform, specifically leveraging containerized deployments via Cloud Run and serverless computing via Cloud Functions.
* Deep technical mastery of Google BigQuery architecture, including nested/repeated fields, materialized views, and BigQuery Omni or ML capabilities.
* Hands-on experience building streaming and batch data processing pipelines using GCP Dataflow services.
* Advanced proficiency in writing complex, optimized SQL queries, with specific hands-on administration and optimization experience using GCP Cloud SQL utilizing the PostgreSQL engine.
* Strong hands-on coding expertise in Python to perform advanced data analysis, data mining, DevSecOps automation, and pipeline orchestration.
* Familiarity with deploying AI-driven automation workflows to improve data pipeline resilience.
* Experience utilizing visualization platforms (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Thoughtspot) to build data-driven stories tailored for business users at all levels.
* Experience embedding Looker visualizations directly into serverless applications or enterprise API frameworks is highly desirable.

**You’ll need to have..**

* Bachelor degree in Computer Science/Information Systems or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.
* Six to eight years of professional experience in data analytics, business analysis or comparable analytics position.
* Advanced proficiency in Python and writing complex, optimized SQL queries, with specific hands-on administration and optimization experience using GCP Cloud SQL utilizing the PostgreSQL engine.
* Ability to write SQL against a relational database in order to analyze and test data.
* Experience with modern DataOps/DevSecOps orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, CI/CD pipelines) applied directly to data engineering.

* Knowledge of securing cloud data delivery layers (OAuth, OIDC, API Gateways) and enforcing data privacy/governance standards.

title: Workday Risk and Controls Consultant
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role:**

  

As a Workday Risk & Controls Consultant, you will support governance, risk, compliance, and controls activities across Workday and related enterprise systems. You will work closely with business stakeholders, risk teams, auditors, cyber security teams, and technology delivery functions to ensure effective control execution, audit readiness, regulatory compliance, and continuous process improvement. The role focuses on strengthening ERP governance, improving control effectiveness, supporting risk mitigation activities, and driving sustainable compliance across both project delivery and business-as-usual operations.

  

**What Will You Do :**

  

* Perform compliance assurance, control testing, monitoring, and governance activities across Workday, IT, operational, and regulatory control environments.
* Support audit readiness by validating evidence, maintaining documentation, tracking issues, and coordinating remediation activities across technology and business teams.
* Partner with internal and external auditors, compliance teams, and stakeholders to support audits, certification activities, customer reviews, and regulatory assessments.
* Develop and maintain risk, control, governance, and compliance artefacts supporting ERP platforms, SDLC processes, operational controls, and business functions.
* Execute and support User Access Reviews (UAR), Segregation of Duties (SoD) assessments, privileged access monitoring, Joiner-Mover-Leaver processes, and change compliance reviews.
* Monitor and assess controls related to SDLC, change management, cyber resilience, disaster recovery, access management, and ongoing operational activities.
* Develop management reports, dashboards, metrics, and compliance insights while identifying control gaps, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives and support the implementation of automation, machine learning, robotic process automation (RPA), and AI-enabled control monitoring solutions.  

  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  
The career path ahead is full of exciting opportunities to grow and advance within the job family. With dedication and hard work, you can climb the ladder to higher bands, achieving coveted positions such as Principal Engineer or Vice President of Software. These roles not only offer the chance to inspire and innovate, but also bring with them a sense of pride and accomplishment for having reached the pinnacle of your career in the software industry.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Experience :**

  

* 3+ years of experience in risk, controls, compliance, governance, audit, ERP controls, or related functions within complex global organizations.
* Experience working with Tier-1 ERP platforms such as Workday, SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics 365 across implementation, transformation, or operational support environments.
* Experience engaging with internal controls, compliance functions, internal audit, external audit, risk management, or Big 4 advisory teams.
* Strong understanding of Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance, internal control frameworks, audit methodologies, risk management, and governance practices.
* Experience supporting User Access Reviews (UAR), Segregation of Duties (SoD), privileged access monitoring, Joiner-Mover-Leaver processes, and change management controls.
* Experience supporting SDLC controls, evidence collection, compliance monitoring, remediation management, and audit readiness activities.
* Strong analytical and reporting capabilities with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, data analysis, control testing, and compliance reporting.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, organizational, documentation, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently across cross-functional teams.  

  

**Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise :**

  

* CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) or equivalent audit, governance, risk, or compliance certification preferred.
* Experience supporting governance, risk, and controls activities within Workday environments, including ERP transformation and operational governance initiatives.
* Experience working in SOX-regulated, highly regulated, or compliance-driven organizations with strong audit and controls requirements.
* Exposure to automation technologies including RPA, Machine Learning, AI, or Agentic AI solutions for compliance monitoring and control optimization.
Experience developing compliance dashboards, KPI reporting, control scorecards, management reporting, and continuous improvement frameworks.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Solutions Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

**Experience**

[8 -12 years]

**Reports to**

[Delivery / Engineering Manager]

**Team**

Leads a lean pod of 3 agent engineers

**About the role**
------------------

As an Agentic Forward Deployed Engineer, you operate at the front line of delivery - embedded with the client, turning ambiguous business problems into production agents, fast. Your deliverable is Business Transformation Agents: autonomous and multi-agent systems that automate and reimagine real business processes such as invoice disputes, procurement approvals, onboarding, claims and compliance workflows. You own each agent end to end -conceptualize, build, integrate, evaluate, deploy, and sustain - and you lead a small team to do the same. You build exclusively in Python using agent development kits, and you bring Agentic AI capabilities to life inside the client's world, with Responsible AI, evaluation and security as non-negotiables.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Conceptualize fast:** embed with stakeholders, frame a business process as an agentic solution, and stand up a working agent prototype in days, not weeks.
* **Build Business Transformation Agents:** design and ship single-agent and multi-agent systems in Python using ADKs that automate and transform real client workflows, with measurable ROI.
* **Own efficiency as the scorecard:** drive delivery efficiency and operational efficiency ; shorter cycle times, less manual effort, higher accuracy, lower cost-to-serve.
* **Engineer the agent core:** apply prompt engineering, context engineering, prompt caching, RAG / context-graph retrieval, memory, tool / function calling, MCP integration and multi-agent orchestration.
* **Integrate to standards:** connect agents into client ecosystems through proven integration patterns, standards-based APIs and secure authentication.
* **Make reusability and predictability the default:** build reusable agent components, skills, tool libraries and templates; add guardrails so agent behaviour is predictable, safe and repeatable.
* **Prototype and iterate quickly:** use the kit's scaffolding to prototype, then harden to production-grade, well-tested Python.
* **Run eval-driven development:** build evaluation harnesses and test suites that measure agent correctness, safety and regression before anything ships.
* **Own AgentOps / DevSecOps:** CI/CD for agents, versioning, observability and telemetry, shift-left security, and Responsible AI governance baked in from day one.
* **Run a continuous, adaptable feedback loop:** feed production telemetry, evals and client feedback back into prompts, context and agent design.
* **Stay ahead of the curve:** adopt evolving agent frameworks and patterns quickly, and bring field learnings back to the practice.
* **Lead and mentor:** set technical direction for a lean team of 3 agent engineers, raise the engineering bar, and grow the pod's agentic capability.
* **What you'll bring (must-have)**
  ---------------------------------

  + **Strong Python engineering ;** idiomatic, typed, tested and packaged code; on a foundation of solid software engineering principles (design, version control, architecture).
  + **Hands-on agent building** with at least one agent development kit (Google ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, AWS Bedrock AgentCore or Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel).
  + **Solid command of agent engineering:** prompt engineering, context engineering, prompt caching, RAG / context graphs, tool / function calling, MCP, and multi-agent orchestration.
  + **Eval-driven development:** designing evaluation harnesses and measuring agent quality, safety and reliability.
  + **Standards-based integration and DevSecOps:** APIs, secure auth, CI/CD, observability and AgentOps.
  + **Ability to conceptualize a business problem as an agent quickly,** and operate effectively in ambiguous, customer-embedded settings.
  + **Client-facing maturity:** translates fluidly between technical and non-technical stakeholders, and owns outcomes.
  + **Experience mentoring or leading** small engineering teams.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

**Technology mandate**
----------------------

**Language:** Python preferable

**Frameworks:** Agent Development Kits (ADKs) ; e.g. Google ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel. Framework choice follows the engagement; the discipline is the same.

**Models:** Multi-LLM via the kit (e.g. Claude on Bedrock, Gemini, Azure OpenAI), selected per use case for quality, latency and cost.

**Interfaces:** Tools and Model Context Protocol (MCP) for integration; standards-based APIs and secure auth for client systems.

  

**What great looks like (strongly preferred)**
----------------------------------------------

* **Fluency across multiple ADKs** and the judgment to pick the right one per engagement.
* **Deploying agents to managed runtimes** at enterprise scale (e.g. Vertex AI Agent Engine, Bedrock AgentCore) with governance and cost control.
* **Domain depth** in a transformation area - finance operations, supply chain, HR, claims or compliance.
* **Experience with an** enterprise agent platform, including Responsible AI and governance at scale.
* **A track record of turning agents into reusable accelerators** or IP adopted beyond a single engagement.

**Must Have Skill**
-------------------

AWS AI/ML (GenAI),Python,LLM-Centric Backend Design
