This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role responsible for defining automation roadmaps, establishing enterprise frameworks and engineering standards, identifying high-value automation opportunities, integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines, and building sustainable automation capabilities that improve software quality, accelerate releases, and reduce manual testing effort.

Key Responsibilities

### **Automation Strategy & Architecture**

* Define and execute the enterprise **test automation vision, roadmap, and target-state architecture**.
* Establish **Playwright** as a strategic automation framework for modern web applications.
* Design scalable and reusable automation architecture covering **web, API, database, batch, and end-to-end testing**.
* Establish automation governance, coding standards, design principles, framework guidelines, and engineering best practices across delivery teams.
* Conduct automation assessments and identify high-value candidates based on business criticality, execution frequency, complexity, maintainability, and ROI.
* Define a unified automation approach for business processes spanning multiple applications and integration layers.
* Establish strategies for **test-data management, environment management, execution orchestration, reporting, and defect diagnostics**.

### **Playwright Automation**

* Architect and develop enterprise-grade **Playwright frameworks using TypeScript or JavaScript**.
* Implement framework patterns including **Page Object Model, fixtures, reusable components, utilities, configuration management, and data-driven testing**.
* Design automation supporting **cross-browser, parallel, UI, and API testing**.
* Automate member, provider, customer service, and other enterprise portals within the healthcare payer ecosystem.
* Implement robust handling of **dynamic elements, synchronization, waits, authentication, test data, retry mechanisms, and flaky tests**.
* Leverage Playwright capabilities such as **traces, screenshots, videos, reporting, network interception, API testing, and parallel execution** for efficient execution and defect analysis.
* Mentor automation engineers and QA teams on Playwright architecture, framework development, coding standards, and troubleshooting practices.

### **API & Integration Automation**

* Define enterprise-level **API automation strategy and architecture**.
* Build reusable automation for REST-based services and application integrations.
* Design automated validation across **UI, API, database, EDI, and batch processing layers**.
* Establish strategies for service-level validation, test-data setup, response validation, negative testing, and integration testing.
* Design end-to-end automated workflows that validate business transactions across multiple systems.
* Integrate API automation with Playwright and other enterprise automation frameworks where appropriate.

### **CI/CD & Quality Engineering**

* Integrate automated test suites with **Azure DevOps, Jenkins, and/or GitHub Actions**.
* Define automation execution strategies across pull requests, continuous integration, regression, release, and scheduled pipelines.
* Enable parallel and distributed execution to improve feedback time.
* Establish automated reporting and quality gates within CI/CD pipelines.
* Track framework and execution metrics including **pass rates, flaky-test rates, execution duration, automation coverage, defect detection, and pipeline stability**.
* Partner with DevOps and engineering teams to implement **shift-left and continuous testing practices**.

### **Solution Design & Delivery**

* Architect end-to-end automation solutions covering **web, API, database, EDI, and batch validation**.
* Evaluate automation technologies and recommend appropriate tools based on application architecture, scalability, maintainability, integration capability, and total cost of ownership.
* Ensure automation platforms meet enterprise requirements for **security, scalability, maintainability, reliability, compliance, and operational sustainability**.
* Define secure test-data management practices appropriate for **HIPAA-regulated healthcare environments**.
* Provide technical leadership throughout framework design, implementation, deployment, migration, and ongoing modernization.
* Conduct architecture reviews and technical reviews of automation solutions developed across delivery teams.

### **Automation CoE & Governance**

* Establish and lead an **Automation Center of Excellence (CoE)**.
* Define enterprise automation standards, reusable assets, reference architectures, framework templates, and governance processes.
* Establish technical review and framework onboarding processes for project teams.
* Develop reusable automation accelerators to improve delivery efficiency across programs.
* Define appropriate KPIs for evaluating automation maturity and effectiveness.
* Drive framework adoption and standardization across multiple products and delivery teams.

### **Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with QA leadership, product teams, business stakeholders, developers, enterprise architects, DevOps, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and delivery teams.
* Present **automation strategies, architecture proposals, investment requirements, business cases, ROI, and roadmaps** to senior leadership.
* Translate business priorities into practical automation strategies.
* Manage technical engagements with automation vendors and strategic partners.
* Influence engineering teams to adopt common quality-engineering and automation practices.

### **Innovation & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive adoption of **Generative AI** for areas such as test-case design, automation script generation, code optimization, test-data generation, failure analysis, and self-healing automation.
* Evaluate emerging automation technologies, AI-assisted testing capabilities, and quality-engineering practices.
* Continuously improve framework performance, reliability, maintainability, and developer experience.
* Monitor automation coverage, stability, execution trends, productivity improvements, ROI, and benefits realization.

  
**Skills**

API Testing, Playwright, FACETS, Test Automation, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Generative AI, JavaScript, Robotic Process Automation, SQL

 **About UST**  
UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

The career path ahead is full of exciting opportunities to grow and advance within the job family. With dedication and hard work, you can climb the ladder to higher bands, achieving coveted positions such as Principal Engineer or Vice President of Software. These roles not only offer the chance to inspire and innovate, but also bring with them a sense of pride and accomplishment for having reached the pinnacle of your career in the software industry.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

* Proven experience leading integration projects, managing stakeholders, conducting workshops, troubleshooting critical production issues, and driving successful delivery outcomes.
Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, leadership, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively with both technical and business teams.  

**Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise:**

* Experience designing integrations across cloud, hybrid, and enterprise application ecosystems using modern integration architectures.
* Experience with DevOps tools, CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, and modern engineering practices.
* Certification in Workday Integration, Workday Extend, or related Workday technical specializations preferred.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, along with certifications in Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), is highly desirable.

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

title: Infrastructure Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Your role Step into the engine room of enterprise technology, where every decision you make can shape how a customer’s systems perform today - and scale for tomorrow. You’ll dive deep into complex infrastructure environments, solving challenging technical problems, designing seamless integrations and ensuring systems run reliably at every level. Your expertise across networks, endpoints and mainframes, paired with a knack for logical problem-solving and clear documentation, will guide projects from concept to execution. Your solutions will make a real impact that customers notice and remember. In this role, you’ll balance hands-on delivery with long-term strategic planning. From analyzing issues and testing solutions to automating processes and integrating across platforms, your work will touch every layer of IT infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with Architects, Technicians and Project Managers, gaining broad exposure and continuous opportunities to grow your skills and influence. What you will do Analyze and Solve •Diagnose complex issues across servers, networks, cloud environments and systems to identify root causes •Recommend solutions that balance technical feasibility, timelines and customer priorities •Test, refine and automate processes to improve reliability, efficiency and repeatability •Assess risks proactively and implement strategies to prevent disruptions Design and Integrate •Plan end-to-end infrastructure solutions across platforms and technologies •Integrate systems in hybrid cloud and on-prem environments to ensure seamless operation •Automate workflows and processes to streamline delivery and reduce errors •Document architectures and procedures for hand-offs, knowledge sharing and operational continuity Collaborate and Deliver •Coordinate cross-functional teams including Architects, Project Managers and Technicians •Drive project delivery from initiation to completion with attention to quality and timelines •Communicate technical solutions clearly to customers and stakeholders •Build customer confidence by delivering tangible, high-impact results Grow and Advance •Expand technical expertise across cloud platforms, enterprise IT systems and emerging technologies •Earn certifications and qualifications while applying them on real projects •Pursue career paths toward Architect or Distinguished Engineer roles

**Who You Are**

Required skills and experience •Deep expertise within specific technology domain areas (e.g., software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) •Enterprise IT application experience •Hands-on experience in at least one of the following: software development, DevOps engineering, systems administration, or systems architecture in public cloud AWS domain •In-depth knowledge of Windows and Linux Operating System Preferred skills and experience •Familiar with a variety of IT concepts, practices, and procedures •Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principals involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models •Logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems •Analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**  
If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior Research Specialist, AI & ML
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. At KLA, physics and data are at the core of everything we do. Our AI and Modeling Center of Excellence drives innovation across KLA products by combining expertise in physics modeling, high-performance computing (HPC) and AI. The group is comprised of top-tier physicists, machine learning engineers, HPC architects and data scientists that collaborate to develop scalable, cutting-edge solutions for our customers. We’re hiring across multiple disciplines—this is your opportunity to make a global impact.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

  
  

The work spans both applied and fundamental research. You will identify high-value research problems, formulate them mathematically, develop novel learning methods, build proof-of-concept systems, and conduct rigorous evaluations. Successful research outcomes will be translated into scalable solutions through collaboration with multidisciplinary engineering and domain teams.

  
  

This role is not focused on building conversational assistants or connecting foundation models through predefined workflows. The central challenge is to develop intelligent systems that interact with analytical tools, reason over heterogeneous engineering data, make sequential decisions, and improve through feedback. We are looking for researchers who view agentic AI as a learning and decision-making problem involving observations, actions, tools, feedback, uncertainty, and measurable outcomes. We value scientific rigor and sound judgment, selecting methods based on the structure of the problem rather than on current trends.

  
  

**What You Will Work On**

  

You will develop intelligent systems capable of:

* Reasoning over images, text, measurements, metadata, and domain knowledge.
* Planning and executing multi-step analytical workflows.
* Selecting and invoking specialized algorithms, models, and software tools.
* Examining intermediate results and deciding what action to take next.
* Learning from expert demonstrations, human feedback, and execution outcomes.
* Improving decision policies through reinforcement learning.
* Explaining decisions using grounded and verifiable evidence.
* Operating reliably in complex scientific and engineering environments.
  

  

**Potential Research Areas**

* Reinforcement learning for foundation-model reasoning and post-training.
* Multimodal agents for engineering analysis and decision support.
* Sequential decision-making for inspection and metrology workflows.
* Adaptive tools, algorithms, measurement, and data acquisition strategies.
* Learning from domain-expert feedback and verifiable execution outcomes.
* Reward design, agent trajectory learning and optimization.
* Human-agent collaboration and knowledge-grounded reasoning.
* Agent reliability, interpretability, and failure of recovery.
* Fine-tuning and evaluating LLMs and VLMs for specialized domains.
  

  

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities**

* Identify high-value opportunities for reinforcement learning, agentic AI, and multimodal reasoning in semiconductor inspection and metrology.
* Formulate scientific and engineering workflows as learning and sequential decision-making problems.
* Design intelligent agents that reason over multimodal data, use specialized tools and adapt their actions based on feedback.
* Develop and evaluate learning methods that improve agent reasoning, planning, tool use, and decision quality.
* Adapt foundation models to specialized scientific and industrial applications.
* Design rigorous experiments to assess performance, reliability, generalization, grounding, and failure recovery.
* Build reproducible prototypes and collaborate with engineering, infrastructure and domain teams to translate successful research into scalable solutions.
* Communicate research findings and collaborate with global multidisciplinary teams.
* Manage a team of engineers working in the space of AI

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

* PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning or a related discipline, with 3 to 5 years of relevant research or industrial experience; or a master’s degree with 5 to 10 years of relevant experience. Candidates with less experience may be considered if they demonstrate an exceptional research or engineering record.
* Strong foundation in at least one of the following: reinforcement learning; sequential decision-making; learning-based agents; foundation-model post-training; or planning and decision-making under uncertainty.
* Hands-on experience designing, implementing or evaluating intelligent agents involving planning, tool use, retrieval, memory, self-correction, multi-step execution, or learning from feedback.
* Working experience with LLMs, VLMs, multimodal foundation models, or generative foundation models.
* Sound understanding of reinforcement-learning concepts, including policies, rewards, value functions, exploration, credit assignment, policy optimization and evaluation.
* Ability to formulate real-world problems in terms of observations, states, actions, rewards, and sequential objectives.
* Strong foundation in deep learning, transformer architectures and representation learning.
* Hands-on experience developing, training, fine-tuning and evaluating models using PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow or a comparable framework.
* Strong Python programming skills and the ability to develop maintainable and reproducible research software.
* Ability to formulate research and engineering problems mathematically.
* Experience designing controlled experiments, defining appropriate baselines, and selecting meaningful evaluation of metrics.
* Ability to analyze experimental results, identify failure modes, and draw evidence-based conclusions.
* Ability to follow rapidly evolving research and translate relevant ideas into working prototypes.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Research or industry experience in reinforcement learning, agentic AI, multimodal learning, or foundation-model adaptation.
* Experience developing intelligent systems that learn from feedback, interact with tools, and operate over extended decision-making horizons.
* Experience training, fine-tuning, or evaluating language, vision-language, or multimodal foundation models.
* Experience developing robust evaluation frameworks for agent performance, reliability, and generalization.
* Experience applying machine learning to complex scientific, engineering, or industrial problems.
* Evidence of strong technical depth across modern machine learning, deep learning, and AI systems research.
* Evidence of team leadership in small or large organizations.
  

  

**Things That Would Make Us Go “Wow”**

* A demonstrated record of advancing the state of the art in reinforcement learning, agentic AI, multimodal learning, or foundation models.
* Experience building intelligent agents that learn from feedback, use tools effectively, and operate reliably in complex environments.
* Evidence of applying advanced AI methods to challenging scientific, engineering, or industrial problems with measurable impact.
* Experience defining rigorous evaluation methodologies for agent performance, reliability, and robustness.
* A track record of translating research innovations into scalable systems, products, or business outcomes..

**About KLA**

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

  
  

**Use of AI Statement**

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.

  
  

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*

  

*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

**Experience required:** Up to 2 years of relevant experience  
**Work schedule:** 24×7 rotational shifts with monthly shift rotation

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an Associate IT Support Engineer to join our 24×7 monitoring and production-support team.

The role involves monitoring applications, infrastructure, cloud resources, and containerized services; investigating alerts using metrics, logs, and traces; and supporting incident response to maintain service availability and performance.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate practical troubleshooting skills, apply knowledge gained through product and application knowledge-transfer (KT) sessions, and communicate technical findings clearly. The role also requires familiarity with AI-assisted troubleshooting and a willingness to use approved AI tools to improve investigation, documentation, and operational efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Continuously monitor applications, infrastructure, cloud resources, and services using available observability tools and existing dashboards.
* Review alerts, events, logs, metrics, and traces using OpenSearch, Grafana, and applicable APM and infrastructure-monitoring platforms.
* Identify application errors, service unavailability, performance degradation, infrastructure failures, and unusual system behaviour.
* Perform initial investigation and troubleshooting using monitoring data, logs, dashboards, and standard operating procedures.
* Monitor Kubernetes clusters, nodes, pods, containers, deployments, and services.
* Use basic SQL queries to retrieve and validate data during application or database-related incident investigations.
* Acknowledge, prioritize, and respond to alerts according to severity, business impact, and established response procedures.

title: AI Ops Engineer
description:
The Ford Credit Global Data Insights and Analytics (FC - GDIA) department is looking for a motivated and talented AI – Ops Engineer with strong cloud infrastructure and AI operations expertise to build, automate, and secure the platform that powers our advanced artificial intelligence solutions for the Ford Credit team.  
In this role, you will act as the backbone of our quantitative analytics and AI engineering teams. Your primary mission will be to design, automate, and operate the end-to-end cloud and AI infrastructure — including CI/CD pipelines, containerized microservices, observability, and platform guardrails — so that our Generative AI applications and modelers can run safely, scalably, and reliably in production.

* **Cloud Platform Engineering:** Architect and operate highly available, multi-service AI infrastructure on the cloud, managing the full lifecycle of compute, storage, networking, and security for AI workloads.
* **AI-Ops / LLMOps Pipelines:** Establish robust MLOps and LLMOps pipelines covering the end-to-end lifecycle of Generative AI tools — including model deployment, version control, prompt and artifact tracking, automated evaluation, and continuous monitoring for performance, drift, and hallucination mitigation.
* **CI/CD Automation:** Design and maintain automated build, test, and deployment pipelines for full-stack AI applications, ensuring seamless and secure continuous integration and delivery across front-end, back-end, and AI components.
* **Infrastructure as Code:** Manage cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Cloud Build, Kubernetes manifests) to deliver reproducible, auditable, and scalable environments.
* **Containerization & Orchestration:** Build and operate containerized microservices (Docker/Kubernetes), managing scaling, rolling deployments, resource optimization, and service resilience for AI workloads.
* **Observability & Reliability:** Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, and SRE practices to ensure platform reliability, availability, and performance of AI applications in production.
* **Security & Governance:** Embed security across the platform — identity and access management, secrets management, network policies, and data protection — ensuring all AI workloads meet Ford's strict data privacy, security, and compliance standards.
* **Developer Enablement:** Work closely with AI engineers, software engineers, and analytical modelers to provide self-service tooling, environments, and automated workflows that remove friction from development to production.  
    
  **Skills Knowledge Required**
  + **Cloud Platform:** Extensive hands-on experience with a leading cloud provider (e.g., Google Cloud Platform), including Cloud Run, Cloud Build, GKE, GCS, BigQuery, IAM, VPC networking, and Secret Manager.
  + **DevOps / SRE Practices:** Strong proficiency in CI/CD tooling, GitOps, containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and cloud-native monitoring and logging.
  + **AI-Ops / LLMOps:** Proficiency in tools and platforms for model deployment, prompt/model versioning, evaluation, tracing, and monitoring of LLM and GenAI outputs.
  + **Scripting & Automation:** Hands-on experience with a programming/scripting language such as Python, or Bash for automating infrastructure and operational tasks, and for building tooling that serves collaborators.
  + **Software Engineering Fundamentals:** Working knowledge of full-stack application architecture and modern deployment patterns for AI tools, with the ability to integrate front-end, back-end, and AI services reliably.
  + **Security & Compliance:** Familiarity with cloud security best practices, identity and access management, secrets management, and compliance standards in regulated environments.
  + **Analytics Workflow Understanding:** Awareness of the typical workflows of data scientists and modelers (data wrangling, feature engineering, model validation) so you can build reliable platforms and pipelines that serve them.
* **Qualifications Experience**
  + **Education:** Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cloud Computing, Data Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  + **DevOps/Cloud Engineering Experience:** 3–5 years of overall experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, or SRE, with at least 1–2 years of dedicated, hands-on experience deploying and operating AI, ML, and Generative AI applications in production.
  + **AI/MLOps Engineering:** Proven track record of implementing CI/CD for AI workloads, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud infrastructure management (Terraform, Cloud Build, GKE).
  + **Automation & Reliability:** Demonstrated experience with infrastructure automation, incident response, and building observable, self-healing production systems.
  + **Good to Have (Optional)::** Previous exposure to the Banking, Financial Services, or Credit Analytics industries. Experience with Machine Learning engineering and model serving frameworks, or relevant cloud certifications (e.g., Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer / Cloud Architect).

title: Associate Technical Lead, Software Development
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The e-Beam division plays a critical role in KLA’s inspection ecosystem, with tools that deliver high-resolution, timely insights into defects and critical locations on the wafer. Used alongside KLA’s patterned and bare wafer inspectors, e-Beam systems help our customers quickly identify and understand yield-impacting issues—enabling faster, more effective actions to correct the manufacturing process.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

  
  

KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays.

The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and in 2019 we invested 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.

With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers.

  

***First to deliver the best imaging and classification data for every defect or point on any layer at any time.***

***Division:***

  

EBeam’s mission encapsulates its role as the “eyes” of KLA’s product line, providing timely information on defects and critical locations on the wafer at the highest spatial resolution possible. Customers use EBeam products alongside KLA patterned and bare wafer inspectors to quickly understand the nature of defects and other imperfections on product wafers and take action to correct the manufacturing process.

KLA's eBeam Division is seeking a passionate software Engineer to join us in delivering high quality solutions for our current and future generation products in our portfolio. We work on exciting problems that fuel the next gen technological advancements in the world! You will be working in teams that build customer critical User interface and Business logic software solutions having a direct impact on the semi-conductor manufacturing processes.

Do you consider yourself as a big picture thinker with solid fundamentals of computer science; an innovator with a curiosity about connecting the dots? Someone who loves to dive deep and is keen on delivering indispensable value to customers? If this sounds like you! We strongly believe you to be a perfect fit for this role. You will work alongside a team of impactful individuals working with outstanding talent from across multiple global regions and functional groups.

You will have the opportunity to learn, design, lead feature development, contribute and collaborate in developing end-to-end software from requirements to delivery. You should be somebody who feels strongly about writing high performing code and would be keen on applying and advocating clean coding practices.

  

**The role would require the following key skills:**
----------------------------------------------------

  
  

* **Expert level experience** in working with **Microsoft .Net and/or C++** programming.
* Solid **Object oriented programming** fundamentals.
* Be responsible for the analysis and addressing of complex requirements in the current software systems for usability and performance.
* Be responsible for developing **innovative architectures** , design and prototypes and working on solutions **for new concepts** that would scale for multiple products.
* Interest and Ability to uncover root causes, devise and drive innovative analyses and solve difficult problems that span whole systems or organizations is crucial.
* **Good debugging skills** in a complex software setup involving multi-process/multiple systems in Windows environment with good OS concepts
* Knowledge of **Semiconductor Factory Automation systems** and standards is an added advantage.
* Thorough knowledge of SDLC and software engineering practices.
Strong verbal and written communication and team-work skills  

  

We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.

  

KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

**Minimum Qualifications**

Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years

**About KLA**

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

  
  

**Use of AI Statement**

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.

  
  

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*

  

*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

description:
**Career Area:**

Engineering

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

Designs, develops, validates, and implements undercarriage components and systems for **Track Type Tractors** / **Dozers**. Responsible for delivering durable, manufacturable, and cost-effective designs that meet customer, quality, and business requirements. Applies engineering expertise to improve product performance, wear life, reliability, and total ownership cost.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and develop undercarriage components including Track Shoes, Track Links, Sprockets, Idlers, Track Rollers, and Carrier Rollers.
* Create and maintain 3D CAD models, engineering drawings, specifications, and product documentation.
* Translate customer, manufacturing, and application requirements into robust design solutions.
* Support New Product Introduction (NPI), Current Product Improvement (CPI), and product quality initiatives.
* Evaluate and improve component durability, wear performance, manufacturability, and cost competitiveness.
* Collaborate with suppliers, manufacturing, quality, and validation teams to ensure successful product implementation.
* Participate in prototype development, testing, validation, and field issue resolution.
* Drive innovation through challenging existing assumptions and identifying opportunities for performance and cost improvements.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in product design and development.
* Experience in heavy equipment, structures, wear components, or undercarriage systems preferred.

Desired Technical Competencies

* Strong knowledge of castings, forgings, metallurgy, heat treatment, and manufacturing processes.
* Understanding of wear mechanisms, tribology, structural life, and fatigue behavior.
* Proficiency in Creo, Teamcenter, GD&T, and engineering drawing standards.
* Ability to interpret and utilize FEA, durability analysis, and performance simulation results to guide design decisions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on root cause analysis and continuous improvement.
* Understanding of product cost drivers and value engineering principles.
* Innovative mindset with the ability to challenge the status quo and develop customer-focused solutions.

**Skill Descriptors**

**Analytical Thinking & AI Utilization**

Ability to analyze complex engineering problems using data, simulations, field performance information, and structured problem-solving techniques. Applies analytical and AI-enabled tools to identify root causes, evaluate alternatives, quantify risks, and make informed design decisions that improve durability, reliability, and customer value.

**Technical Excellence & Innovation**

Applies engineering expertise in undercarriage systems, wear technologies, materials, and manufacturing processes to solve technical challenges. Continuously develops technical knowledge, drives innovation, challenges conventional solutions, and contributes to product performance, reliability, and cost improvements.

**Computer-Aided Design & Engineering**

Ability to utilize Creo, Teamcenter, FEA, durability analysis, and simulation tools to develop, analyze, validate, and optimize product designs. Applies digital engineering methods to improve design quality, reduce development risk, and accelerate product development.

**Product Design & Development**

Ability to design, develop, validate, and implement undercarriage products from concept through production. Supports NPI, CPI, quality improvement, and cost reduction initiatives while delivering solutions that improve performance, wear life, reliability, and customer value.

title: AI and Agent Engineer - Senior Associate
description:
**Position Summary**

The Senior AI and Agent Engineer will develop, integrate, test, deploy, and monitor AI-enabled applications and agents across the Microsoft ecosystem. The role is responsible for the intelligence, orchestration, actions, integrations, and behavioral quality of AI solutions.

This is an AI application engineering role, not a prompt-writing position. The successful candidate must be able to build production software, integrate enterprise systems, create evaluation frameworks, troubleshoot complex behavior, and operate deployed solutions.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**AI and agent development**

* Build and configure Copilot Studio agents, topics, actions, triggers, workflows, and generative orchestration.
* Develop AI applications using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, and supporting Azure services.
* Implement retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs, tool use, multistep orchestration, and human approval patterns.
* Develop custom APIs, Azure Functions, connectors, and supporting application services.
* Integrate AI solutions with Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Power Platform, and approved enterprise systems.

**Prompt, context, and behavior engineering**

* Develop system instructions, prompts, grounding logic, response structures, fallback behavior, and escalation rules.
* Implement model selection and routing based on accuracy, risk, latency, and consumption requirements.
* Design agent behavior that distinguishes between answering, recommending, requesting clarification, escalating, and taking action.
* Maintain version control for prompts, instructions, tools, actions, and model configurations.

**Testing and evaluation**

* Develop evaluation datasets with practice SMEs.
* Automate tests for groundedness, relevance, completeness, citation quality, task completion, response consistency, and escalation behavior.
* Perform adversarial testing involving prompt injection, data leakage, unsupported instructions, excessive agency, and unauthorized actions.
* Build regression tests to detect changes caused by models, prompts, source content, integrations, or application releases.
* Document known limitations and expected failure behavior.

**Operations and improvement**

* Instrument solutions for usage, latency, failures, cost, task completion, user feedback, and model behavior.
* Review production telemetry and interaction patterns.
* Investigate incidents and implement corrective changes.
* Optimize token consumption, retrieval performance, application latency, and integration reliability.
* Develop reusable agent templates, integration components, evaluation harnesses, and error-handling patterns.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong Python development skills.
* TypeScript or JavaScript development experience.
* REST APIs, JSON, OAuth, OpenAPI, webhooks, and event-driven integration.
* Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and Azure AI Search.
* Microsoft Graph, Dataverse, SharePoint, and Teams integration.
* Retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, and structured generation.
* Agent orchestration, state management, tool invocation, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Automated testing, Git, pull requests, CI/CD, and production troubleshooting.
* Application Insights, Azure Monitor, logging, alerting, and performance diagnostics.
* Understanding of prompt injection, data exfiltration, overreliance, hallucination, unsafe actions, and AI-specific failure modes.

**Preferred Experience**

* 5 or more years of software, integration, automation, or data application development.
* Demonstrated production experience with generative AI or conversational AI applications.
* Experience building applications across Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Azure.
* Familiarity with Semantic Kernel or comparable orchestration frameworks.
* Basic C# experience within the Microsoft ecosystem.
* Experience in regulated, confidential, or professional-services environments.

**Success Measures**

* Evaluation performance against approved acceptance thresholds.

title: Platform & Solution Engineering Lead
description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Platform and Solution Engineering Lead owns the technical foundation on which the entire Digital Quality (DQ) portfolio is built, delivered and operated. Digital Quality delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer, and this role is accountable for the platforms, engineering capability and delivery pipelines that allow that portfolio to move at pace while remaining compliant, secure and supportable.

The incumbent leads a global engineering organisation covering platform engineering, solution architecture and design, integration and data engineering, DevSecOps, environment and release management, and vendor delivery oversight. Accountability spans the full technology mix — Software as a Service (SaaS), commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and in-house developed solutions — ensuring each is engineered, integrated, validated and operated to a consistent standard rather than as isolated stacks.

The role is the engineering counterpart to the DQ Solution Leads, who own product strategy and business outcomes, and to the Scaled AI and Solution Architect, who sets cross-portfolio architecture direction and standards; this role is accountable for making those standards real in code, configuration, pipelines and operations. It is also the principal point of alignment between Digital Quality and the wider enterprise technology landscape, including Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organisation, and central platform and infrastructure teams. The role is global in scope, spanning the PGS network, R&D, commercial markets and corporate locations.  
  
**ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES**  
**Platform Engineering and Technical Foundation**

* Own the strategy, engineering and lifecycle of the shared technical foundation for Digital Quality, including cloud footprint, runtime platforms, shared services, reusable components, developer tooling and non-production environments.
* Build the foundation as a product used by delivery teams across the portfolio, with defined service levels, roadmaps, adoption measures and a managed path for retiring legacy and duplicated technology.

**Solution Engineering Across SaaS, COTS and Custom Build**

* Provide engineering leadership and design accountability across the full technology mix, establishing how SaaS platforms are configured and extended, how COTS products are deployed and integrated, and how in-house applications are designed, built and maintained.
* Ensure engineering rigour, supportability and consistent quality regardless of delivery model, and prevent unmanaged customisation that undermines upgradability and cost of ownership.

**Integration and Data Engineering**

* Own the integration and data engineering layer connecting Digital Quality solutions to each other and to the wider Pfizer landscape, including manufacturing, laboratory, enterprise resource planning and enterprise data platforms.
* Establish reusable integration patterns, interfaces and data contracts, and ensure integrations are resilient, monitored, documented and compliant with data integrity requirements.

**DevSecOps, Release and Environment Management**

* Define and run the engineering operating model for Digital Quality, covering source control, continuous integration and delivery pipelines, automated testing, security scanning, infrastructure as code, and environment and release management.
* Drive automation of validation and compliance evidence so that release frequency, deployment reliability and lead time improve without weakening GxP control.
* Own the release calendar and change governance across the portfolio, including coordination of platform vendor release cycles.

**Vendor and Managed Service Delivery**

* Hold strategic technology vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners to account for engineering quality, delivery commitments, security posture and service performance.
* Shape sourcing strategy and the internal-versus-partner capability mix, define technical standards and acceptance criteria in statements of work, and manage capacity and demand across internal and external engineering teams.

**Enterprise Technology Alignment**

* Act as the principal interface between Digital Quality and enterprise technology functions, ensuring DQ solutions adopt enterprise platforms, standards and services rather than building parallel capability.
* Influence enterprise roadmaps, standards and investment decisions on behalf of the QSEO domain, and represent Digital Quality in enterprise architecture, cyber security and technology governance forums.

**Organisational Leadership**

* Lead, develop and grow a global engineering team of approximately 8–10 direct reports, spanning platform engineers, solution architects, integration and data engineers, DevSecOps and release specialists, alongside matrixed and contract resources.
* Build engineering capability, talent pipelines and succession plans; set technical performance expectations and career pathways; and foster a culture of engineering excellence, automation, innovation, accountability and continuous improvement across Digital Quality.

**Compliance, Risk and Governance**

* Ensure the technical foundation and all solutions built on it are maintained in a validated and compliant state in accordance with GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) guidelines, computerised system validation expectations, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements.
* Maintain audit and inspection readiness for engineering processes and evidence, support internal audits and regulatory inspections, and balance pace of innovation with regulatory compliance through effective governance and risk management.

**QUALIFICATIONS**  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in software or platform engineering, technical delivery leadership or engineering management (9+ years with an MS/MBA; 7+ years with a PhD), including accountability for engineering across a portfolio rather than a single application.
* Demonstrated experience leading, hiring and developing engineering teams at scale, including matrix leadership of vendor and contract resources across multiple geographies.
* Deep hands-on grounding in cloud platform engineering, integration architecture and modern software engineering practice, with practical experience of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and security-in-the-pipeline.
* Experience delivering and operating across SaaS, COTS and custom-developed solutions, including vendor platform configuration, extension and upgrade management.
* Strong experience with Agile ways of working; SAFe preferred.
* Knowledge of financial management and procurement activities, with the ability to manage complex budgets, vendor contracts and internal-versus-partner capacity decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated manufacturing environment, including GxP computerised system validation, data integrity and inspection readiness
* Experience automating validation and compliance evidence within CI/CD pipelines in a regulated context.
* Working knowledge of quality, or EHS platforms and their integration landscape (for example Veeva, LIMS, Cority, Enablon).
* Experience engineering or operating AI and data capability in production, in partnership with architecture and data functions.
* Demonstrated success leading technology rationalisation, platform consolidation or large-scale migration programmes.
* Recognised cloud or architecture certification.

**PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS**

Typical desk job; no specific physical or mental requirements beyond standard office work.  
  
**NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS**

Occasional travel up to 20%

Ability to meet with colleagues virtually across different regions and time zones, including occasional out-of-hours working to support deployment go-lives and hypercare.  
  
**ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**  
Reports into Pfizer Digital, PGS, Enabling Functions & Enterprise Platforms - Quality Solutions Lead.

Key business stakeholders include Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organization, central cloud, infrastructure and platform teams, Digital Compliance and Computerized System Validation.

External: strategic software and cloud vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners.  
  
**RESOURCES MANAGED**  
**Financial Accountability**

Annual accountability of approximately $10M across platform, cloud consumption, engineering services and managed service investment, including business case development and investment recommendations for the Digital Quality technical foundation  
**Supervision**

Direct leadership of approximately 8 colleagues, including platform engineers, solution architects,integration and data engineers, and DevSecOps and release specialists. Accountability for external partner and managed service relationships, including contract and systems integrator resources working across the Digital Quality portfolio under the colleague's leadership.

title: GenAI Lead
description:
Orion Innovation is a premier, award-winning, global business and technology services firm. Orion delivers game-changing business transformation and product development rooted in digital strategy, experience design, and engineering, with a unique combination of agility, scale, and maturity. We work with a wide range of clients across many industries including financial services, professional services, telecommunications and media, consumer products, automotive, industrial automation, professional sports and entertainment, life sciences, ecommerce, and education.

  

**Job Overview:**

We are seeking an innovative and highly skilled **Lead Generative AI (GenAI) Engineer** to spearhead the design, development, and deployment of advanced AI-powered solutions. In this role, you will lead a team of engineers and data scientists to harness cutting-edge Generative AI technologies and implement them to solve complex business problems, enhance user experiences, and drive innovation. This role combines deep technical expertise, leadership, and a strong understanding of AI trends and tools.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Technical Leadership:
  + Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of Generative AI solutions.
  + Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and data scientists working on GenAI projects.
  + Stay updated with the latest trends, research, and advancements in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Solution Development:
  + Architect, train, and fine-tune state-of-the-art LLMs and generative AI models
  + Develop and optimize pipelines for prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and domain-specific fine-tuning.
  + Develop and deploy generative AI models, particularly focusing on ChatGPT, using Python on Azure or AWS Platform or .Net on Azure platform
  + Ensure scalability, performance, and security of AI solutions deployed in production.
  + Integration and Deployment:
* API Development:
  + Ability to define and deliver API access for GenAI services, facilitating integration with other systems and applications.
  + Collaborate with software engineering teams to integrate GenAI solutions into enterprise applications and services.
  + Utilize cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP) to deploy and manage AI models and APIs.
  + Leverage MLOps practices for continuous model monitoring, retraining, and improvement.
* Data Strategy and Preparation:
  + Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure high-quality data acquisition, preprocessing, and augmentation for model training and fine-tuning.
  + Implement data governance and privacy practices in line with organizational policies.
* Innovation and Research:
  + Experiment with new generative AI techniques, such as multimodal AI, reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), and active learning.
  + Evaluate and recommend AI frameworks, libraries, and platforms for project requirements.
* Stakeholder Collaboration:
  + Work closely with product managers, business stakeholders, and UX designers to define AI-powered product features and use cases.
  + Present technical concepts, project progress, and AI capabilities to non-technical audiences.

**Key Requirements**

* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms and services for AI/ML, such as Azure AI Services, Azure Machine Learning, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI.
* Hands on experience in any of LLMs such as OpenAI's ChatGPT Models , Gemini, Llama 2 ,Claude 2 ,Grok
* Hands on experience in any of the agentic frameworks like LangChain, Semantic kernel, AutoGen, CrewAi
* Hands on experience using any of vector database like Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate, Faiss
* Experience with multimodal AI and advanced techniques like Tree-of-Thoughts, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF)
* Strong expertise in LLMs and generative AI frameworks like OpenAI, Hugging Face Transformers, or similar platforms.
* Deep understanding of natural language processing (NLP) concepts, including tokenization, embeddings, and sequence-to-sequence models.
* Proficiency in Python and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Scikit-learn.
* Experience in CI/CD pipeline management and automation tools, particularly within the Azure DevOps environment. Knowledge of containerization (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools is also important
* Familiarity with MLOps tools and practices, such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or Docker.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field (Ph.D. preferred).
* 8+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, with 2+ years specifically in Generative AI.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in building Conversational AI applications using cloud-based services and in orchestrating AI/ML services for building a complete solution
* Minimum of 6 years of extensive full-time experience in Data Analysis, Statistics, Machine Learning, or Computer Science
* Proven track record of leading AI projects from inception to production.
* Experience with multimodal AI and advanced techniques like Tree-of-Thoughts, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF).
* Certifications in AI/ML or cloud platforms (e.g., Azure AI Engineer, AWS Certified Machine Learning).

Orion is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Your use of Orion services is governed by any applicable terms in this notice and our general Privacy Policy.

title: Conversational AI Architect - Google Cloud Gemini CX
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. We are seeking a **Conversational AI Architect** to design, build and scale enterprise-grade conversational and agentic AI solutions on Google Cloud. This role combines deep technical expertise in Gemini CX, Dialogflow CX and Vertex AI with hands-on engineering leadership to move generative AI agents from pilot to secure, high-volume production environments.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and deploy enterprise-grade agentic AI and conversational AI solutions using Gemini CX, Vertex AI Agent Studio, Dialogflow CX and supporting Google Cloud AI services
* Orchestrate hybrid conversational workflows by combining generative playbooks and autonomous agent behaviors with deterministic Dialogflow CX state-machine controls
* Build and optimize RAG pipelines using Vertex AI Search to securely ground agents in enterprise documents, knowledge repositories and business data
* Develop secure backend integrations, connectors and webhooks using Cloud Run, Cloud Functions and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to integrate CRM, ERP and internal enterprise systems
* Implement security and compliance guardrails using Model Armor, VPC Service Controls, IAM least-privilege policies and appropriate data isolation controls
* Build conversation telemetry and analytics pipelines using BigQuery and CCAI Insights for error-taxonomy analysis, intent health, containment reporting and operational improvement
* Provide hands-on engineering leadership, write production-grade code, troubleshoot complex platform issues and guide solutions through production deployment and scale

**Requirements**

* 12-20 years of overall experience in IT
* Expertise in Gemini CX, Google Cloud Contact Center AI (CCAI), Vertex AI Agent Studio and the Advanced Agent Modeling (AAM) framework
* Proven experience designing and deploying agentic and conversational AI systems, including goal-oriented agents, multi-agent workflows and enterprise-scale customer interaction solutions
* Expertise in Dialogflow CX, including pages, parameters, conditional routing, transition routes, Speech-to-Text tuning, Text-to-Speech and telephony/SIP configurations
* Experience building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using Vertex AI Search and grounding AI agents securely with enterprise knowledge sources
* Proficiency in Python or Node.js, with hands-on development of APIs, webhooks, connectors and backend integrations using Cloud Run and Cloud Functions
* Knowledge of GCP infrastructure, BigQuery, Looker Studio, Terraform, IAM, VPC Service Controls, Model Armor, cloud security, data anonymization and enterprise security controls
* Proven experience moving generative AI agents from pilot/MVP stages into secure, scalable and high-volume production environments

**Nice to have**

* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Data Engineer certification
* Completion of Google Cloud Agentic AI or Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience (GECX) learning paths, and experience with automation libraries such as dfcx-scrapi
* Experience delivering high-volume customer service solutions in Financial Services, Telecom, Retail or Healthcare environments

title: Senior IT Consultant-AI Acceleration
description:

With a global team of 5600+ IT professionals, DHL IT Services connects people and keeps the global economy running by continuously innovating and creating sustainable digital solutions. We work beyond global borders and push boundaries across all dimensions of logistics. You can leave your mark shaping the technology backbone of the biggest logistics company of the world. Our P&P AI SQUAD is expanding to support AI-empowered, feature-driven software development tailored to Post & Parcel requirements. This role is embedded directly within P&P Solutions, working alongside product teams and domain experts to apply AI to real business-critical software and delivery challenges: you will work directly with product teams and domain experts to accelerate business-critical software in areas such as End Customer Solutions, Billing Solutions, Mobile Solutions, Customer Touchpoint Solutions, Self Service Solutions, Store Solutions, Pension Solutions, Production, Transport and Business Intelligence.

You will join as a **senior AI expert**, operating across IT Consulting, Solution Architecture, Technical Leadership and Principal Engineering responsibilities depending on the product need. The role combines deep AI and DevSecOps expertise with **hands-on engineering and coaching**.

*#DHL #DHLITServices #GreatPlace #PPSolutions #AgenticAI #DevSecOps #Copilot*

**Grow together**

As a **Senior IT Consultant for AI Acceleration**, you will work with P&P product teams to identify, design and implement responsible AI capabilities across the software delivery lifecycle. You will translate customer needs, product priorities, pain points and feature ideas into clearly defined AI-assisted delivery outcomes.

Your work will span requirements engineering, solution options and blueprints, architecture, code generation, testing, documentation, knowledge management, application support and operations. You will use Copilot, AI agents and approved AI tooling to accelerate delivery while maintaining human control over prioritization, decisions, quality and accountability.

**Working model**

**The** **SQUAD** combines senior AI expertise with P&P product and software expertise. AI experts inject capabilities, reusable assets, coaching and hands-on support. Product teams continue to own business value, backlog priorities, delivery commitments, acceptance, quality and compliance. Implementation is performed as a mixed team, with AI expertise engaged according to the priority and maturity of the product need.

**What you do**

* Implement reusable AI assets tailored to P&P Solutions needs while using and fulfilling DHL and Agent Friday standards.
* Coach and complement product teams through hands-on AI implementation, from exploration and co-design through engineering and handover.
* Integrate AI into DevSecOps practices for requirements, architecture, engineering, code, testing, documentation, knowledge and operations.
* Create solution options and blueprints that consider security, performance, compliance, maintainability and operational readiness.
* Apply Copilot, AI agents and other approved AI tools using effective prompting, engineering patterns and repeatable playbooks.
* Partners with architects, technical leads, developers, testers, product owners and domain experts in a co-creation model.
* Maximize AI efficiency and demonstrate outcomes through transparent measures such as delivery acceleration, quality improvement, reuse and reduced manual effort.
* Identify and address AI risks, limitations and quality concerns, keeping human review and accountability embedded in the delivery process.
* Enable knowledge transfer so product teams can sustainably operate, extend and reuse the implemented capabilities.
* Support priority P&P products and domains, including End Customer Solutions, Billing Solutions, Mobile Solutions and other customer-facing or operational solutions.

**Ready to embark on the journey? Here’s what we are looking for:**

* Substantial experience in AI-assisted software engineering, generative AI or agentic AI, with strong hands-on delivery experience.
* Profound knowledge of integrating AI into software engineering and DevSecOps workflows.
* Experience with AI/LLM application development, including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool/function calling, AI agents, model evaluation and integration of AI services into enterprise applications.
* Practical expertise with GitHub Copilot or comparable coding assistants, AI agents, prompt engineering, reusable patterns and playbooks.
* Strong software engineering foundation, including architecture, clean code, APIs, automated testing, CI/CD, secure development and production operations.
* Ability to create solution options and translate ambiguous business needs into clear technical designs, prototypes and production-ready approaches.
* Working knowledge of responsible AI, security, privacy, compliance, model limitations, evaluation and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Hands-on coaching mindset with the ability to transfer knowledge and raise the AI capability of multidisciplinary product teams.
* Experience working in complex enterprise environments with distributed, cross-regional teams.
* Excellent spoken and written English, strong stakeholder communication and the ability to explain AI opportunities and constraints without hype.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively and organize work under time and workload pressure.

**Experience that will help you stand out**

* Experience in logistics, postal, parcel, retail, billing, customer-facing digital channels or mobile application domains.
* Familiarity with P&P concepts such as customer journeys, touchpoints, Packstation/Poststation, billing and finance, mobile apps, pension services, production, transport or BI solutions.
* Experience with cloud-native platforms, containers, infrastructure as code, observability, performance engineering or application security.
* Previous work as an IT Consultant, Solution Architect, Technical Lead, Principal Engineer or senior software engineer in product-led delivery.
* Experience establishing reusable AI assets, engineering guardrails, evaluation approaches or communities of practice.

title: AI Engineer
description:
**Career Area:**

Technology, Digital and Data

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Caterpillar IT is at the forefront of enabling Caterpillar’s digital transformation, delivering technology solutions that support our global business, manufacturing operations, products, and customers. We leverage data, cloud technologies, advanced analytics, AI, and modern software engineering to build secure, scalable, and innovative solutions that improve operational efficiency and help Caterpillar build a better, more sustainable world.

Build the Digital Backbone of Modern Manufacturing

We’re assembling a dynamic team to develop and scale our Manufacturing & Supply Digital Platform—a next-generation software framework that transforms how manufacturing and supply operations connect, collaborate, and optimize.

This platform is not an ERP system. It’s a purpose-built digital layer that integrates data, processes, and resources across the entire manufacturing lifecycle—from design and engineering to production and distribution.

This initiative is powered by NVIDIA technologies, including the Omniverse platform and AI computing capabilities, enabling immersive digital twins, accelerated simulation, and intelligent automation. You’ll be part of a team that’s not just building software—but shaping the future of how manufacturing works through AI-driven, collaborative, and scalable digital solutions.

As part of this initiative, you’ll contribute to:

* System Integration: Seamlessly connecting diverse manufacturing and supply systems, data sources, and workflows into a unified digital ecosystem.
* Data-Driven Decision Making: Harnessing real-time data collection, analysis, and visualization to deliver actionable insights and operational intelligence.
* Automation & Optimization: Driving efficiency through intelligent scheduling, AI Agents, predictive maintenance, and quality control—without replacing core transactional systems.
* Enhanced Collaboration: Enabling transparent communication and coordination across teams, functions, and geographies.

If you're passionate about digital platforms, industrial innovation, and working with cutting-edge technologies—this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Build, integrate, and optimize AI Assistants and agent-based solutions capable of retrieving information, executing workflows, and supporting business processes through natural language interactions.

* Collaborate with product, engineering, and domain teams to define requirements, translate business needs into AI capabilities, and deliver production-ready solutions.
* Implement observability, monitoring, evaluation, and feedback mechanisms to measure AI Assistant performance, identify issues, and drive continuous improvement.
* Support deployment, productionization, and operational readiness activities, including security, entitlements, access controls, auditability, and governance requirements.

* Experience with Agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar orchestration platforms.

* Experience building and deploying AI Assistants, Copilots, or conversational AI solutions for business or operational use cases.
* Exposure to agent orchestration, tool calling, workflow automation, and multi-agent systems.
* Deep expertise in Python especially with PyTorch/TensorFlow (model training, fine-tuning for vision, text, and audio; Supervised, Unsupervised, Reinforcement learning experience is a plus).
