title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)About the role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you work directly with customers to understand their business problems and turn them into working solutions built on Claude. You will sit between the customer’s teams and our product and engineering teams. You will run discovery, define requirements, and build and ship AI-powered workflows that deliver measurable results in the customer’s environment.

What you’ll do

* Run discovery sessions with customer stakeholders (business users, IT, operations) to uncover pain points, workflows, and success criteria.
* Turn ambiguous business needs into clear requirements, user stories, and technical specs.
* Design, prototype, and deploy solutions using Claude (prompting, tool use, agents, and integrations with customer systems).
* Integrate with customer systems such as ERP, CRM, databases, and internal APIs.
* Evaluate and iterate: build test sets, measure quality, and tune prompts and workflows for accuracy, cost, and latency.
* Support customers through rollout with demos, documentation, training, and troubleshooting.
* Feed customer learnings back to product and engineering to shape the roadmap and reusable solutions.

What we’re looking for

**Must have**

* Strong hands-on skill using Claude and LLMs effectively: prompt design, structured outputs, tool/function calling, context management, and evaluation.
* Proven ability to gather and document requirements, ask the right questions, and translate business language into technical solutions.
* Solid programming skills (Python and/or TypeScript/JavaScript), plus experience with REST APIs, JSON, and SQL.
* Clear communication with both technical and non-technical audiences, including presenting demos and writing concise documentation.
* Comfort working independently in ambiguous, customer-facing situations and owning outcomes end to end.

**Nice to have**

* Prior experience in ERP development or implementation (for example SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, Odoo, or similar), including customization, modules, data models, and integrations.
* Understanding of business processes such as finance, procurement, inventory, supply chain, HR, or order-to-cash.
* Experience with integration patterns (ETL, webhooks, middleware, MCP servers).
* Background in consulting, solutions engineering, or professional services.
* Experience with cloud platforms and basic security and compliance practices (access control, data privacy).

Pay: Up to ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Engr III Spec-AI Science
description:
### **When you join Verizon**

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

We are looking for a highly skilled **Engineer III, AI Science** to design, build, and scale our next generation of AI systems. In this senior technical role, you will be a key driver in transitioning our machine learning capabilities from traditional predictive modeling to advanced Agentic and Prescriptive AI paradigms.

You will be hands-on in developing autonomous AI agents, large language model (LLM) pipelines, and reinforcement learning engines that optimize customer lifecycles, automate complex workflows, and drive measurable business value. You will also serve as a technical lead on high-impact projects, mentoring junior engineers and shaping our internal AI engineering standards.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Agentic AI & LLM Development**

* Design, build, and deploy multi-agent systems and autonomous workflows using modern frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI).
* Develop robust LLM-based applications capable of reasoning, tool-use, and executing complex, multi-step tasks for dynamic customer interactions and internal automation.
* Implement guardrails, evaluation frameworks (LLM-as-a-judge), and prompt-engineering best practices to ensure safe, reliable, and compliant agent behavior in production.

**2. Predictive & Prescriptive Modeling**

* Build state-of-the-art predictive models (deep learning, sequence models, tree-based models) for forecasting customer behavior, churn, propensity, and lifetime value (CLTV).
* Develop prescriptive optimization engines using Reinforcement Learning (RL), Contextual Bandits, or mathematical optimization to power real-time "Next Best Action" (NBA) and dynamic pricing recommendations.
* Apply causal inference and uplift modeling techniques to measure and optimize the true incremental impact of AI-driven interventions.

**3. Production Engineering & MLOps**

* Collaborate with MLOps and Data Engineering teams to deploy machine learning and agentic models into highly scalable, low-latency production environments.
* Write production-grade, optimized code (Python) and build robust API endpoints for AI service integration.
* Design and maintain telemetry for monitoring model drift, agent hallucination rates, and overall system performance.

**4. Technical Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead the end-to-end technical execution of complex AI projects, from ideation and prototyping to production deployment.
* Mentor Engineer I and II team members, conduct rigorous code/model reviews, and foster a culture of continuous learning.
* Partner closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Business Stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions.

### **Required Qualifications**

* **Education:** Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
* **Experience:** 5+ years of applied industry experience in machine learning, AI science, or data engineering (or 3+ years with a Ph.D.).
* **Technical Skills:**Advanced proficiency in **Python** and standard ML libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, XGBoost/LightGBM).Hands-on experience building and deploying **LLMs and Agentic AI** (LangChain, OpenAI APIs, open-source models like Llama 3/Mistral, RAG architectures).Strong foundation in **Predictive and Prescriptive ML** methodologies (time-series, reinforcement learning, optimization algorithms).Solid SQL skills and experience with big data processing (Spark, Databricks, Snowflake).
* **Engineering Best Practices:** Experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines for ML.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience building AI engines specifically for Base Management, Marketing Tech, or Customer Value Management (CVM).
* Experience with Causal Machine Learning (DoWhy, EconML).
* Active contributor to open-source AI projects or a portfolio demonstrating complex agentic workflow development.

### **Where you’ll be working**

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

### **Scheduled Weekly Hours**

40

title: Technical Lead
description:
*At FourKites we have the opportunity to tackle complex challenges with real-world impacts. Whether it's medical supplies from Cardinal Health or groceries for Walmart, the FourKites platform helps customers operate global supply chains that are efficient, agile and sustainable.*

*Join a team of curious problem solvers that celebrates differences, leads with empathy and values inclusivity****.***

We are hiring Technical Lead for the most data-intensive parts of our platform: Ocean Visibility and/or Order Inventory Visibility (OV/IV).
  
Select which domain you are drawn to, or let us help you pick.  
  
As a Technical Lead you are the engineering owner of your team's delivery. You are accountable for what ships, when it ships and how well it is built. You set the technical direction, you hold the bar on engineering practices, and you stay hands-on in the code — typically 40–60% of your week. This is explicitly not a people management role. You will not own headcount, performance reviews, compensation or career ladders — your Engineering Manager does. You own the technical and delivery outcome of the team, and the Engineering Manager owns the people. You operate

**Who you are:**

* 8+ years building and operating production software, including 2+ years as a tech lead, staff engineer or equivalent leading a team's technical delivery.  
  + Deep backend expertise in Java (Spring Boot) and/or Go, with strong fundamentals in distributed systems and object-oriented design.
  + Hands-on experience designing microservices and event-driven systems — Kafka or similar — including idempotency, ordering, replay and failure handling.
  + Strong data modelling and SQL skills on PostgreSQL (or equivalent), plus practical experience with caching (Redis) and query/performance tuning at scale.

  + Production experience on AWS with containerised deployments, CI/CD and modern observability tooling.
  + A track record of shipping complex, multi-quarter work on time — and of being the person who found the risk early.
  + Demonstrated ability to lift a team's engineering practices, not just your own output, through standards, review and mentorship.
  + Excellent written and verbal communication — you can write a design doc an executive and a junior engineer both understand.
  + Comfortable with influence rather than authority: you get the team to a better answer without owning anyone's performance review.
  + Fluent in Agile delivery and the tooling around it (Jira, Confluence, Git branching and rebasing).
  + Comfortable working with a distributed US–India team and with customers directly.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Own delivery  
  + Own the end-to-end technical delivery of your team's roadmap — from breaking down an epic into sequenced, atomic units of work through to production release.
  + Partner with the Product Manager and Engineering Manager to shape scope, sequence work realistically and say no to the things that will not fit.
  + Run sprint-level execution: identify risk early, surface and clear blockers, and keep commitments honest and predictable.
  + Be the single technical point of accountability when a release slips, a migration goes sideways or a customer escalation lands on the team.
  + Drive production health for your services — SLOs, on-call quality, alert hygiene, and root-cause follow-through rather than repeat firefighting.  
  Set technical direction  
  + Own the architecture of your domain: service boundaries, data models, event contracts and integration patterns, aligned with the FourKites North Star architecture.
  + Write and review design documents; make the calls that need making and document the trade-offs behind them.
  + Evaluate frameworks, tools and third-party/partner APIs; decide what we build, what we buy and what we integrate.
  + Maintain a live view of technical debt in your domain and negotiate a steady share of roadmap capacity to pay it down.
  + Design for the scale we actually run at — millions of supply chain events a day, across 80+ countries and 1,600+ global brands.

  Hold the engineering bar for the whole team  
  + Define and enforce the team's engineering standards: coding conventions, test strategy and coverage expectations, PR size and review turnaround, branching, observability and documentation.
  + Review code with intent — catch design problems, not just style — and keep review latency low so the team stays unblocked.
  + Make quality measurable. Watch and improve the signals that matter: change failure rate, revert and hotfix rate, escaped defects, MTTR, cycle time from first commit to production.
  + Raise the floor, not just the ceiling: make sure best practices hold across every engineer on the team, including the newest one.
  + Champion secure-by-default and well-instrumented software — tests, tracing, metrics and alerts are part of done, not a follow-up ticket.  
  Multiply the team  
  + Mentor engineers through design reviews, pairing and code review — technical growth, with career growth left to the Engineering Manager.
  + Give the EM and PM a clear, unvarnished read on the team's technical capability and delivery risk.

title: Sr. Test Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**

Serve as a senior test analyst specializing in MES validation and automation for hybrid work model projects ensuring high quality manufacturing execution solutions through rigorous functional integration and AI assisted testing. Apply expertise in Camstar MES platforms and multi layer integration to improve reliability reduce defects and support efficient supply chain operations while collaborating with diverse global teams.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and execute comprehensive test strategies for MES validation that align with project scope regulatory expectations and enterprise quality standards ensuring reliable delivery of manufacturing execution capabilities across hybrid work environments.
* Develop and maintain detailed automated test suites for MES applications using suitable frameworks focusing on regression coverage repeatability and rapid feedback to project teams to reduce release cycle times and production defects.
* Perform thorough manual functional and integration testing for MES features where automation is not yet feasible documenting clear test conditions reproducible steps and evidence to support release readiness decisions.
* Validate and test MES L4 L3 and L2 integration flows across enterprise planning systems shop floor control systems and field devices ensuring accurate data exchange timing and transaction integrity for manufacturing and supply chain scenarios.
* Configure and validate Camstar MES features workflows and business rules in test environments ensuring that process configurations meet user requirements while upholding data integrity and traceability standards for regulated manufacturing contexts.
* Utilize generative AI tools in a compliant manner to accelerate test design test data generation and defect analysis while applying critical judgment to review AI generated outputs for accuracy relevance and risk.
* Collaborate closely with business analysts developers MES engineers and operations stakeholders to clarify requirements define acceptance criteria and proactively identify risks or gaps that could impact manufacturing continuity or supply chain visibility.
* Analyze test results and production like data patterns to identify systemic defects performance bottlenecks and integration issues then work with technical teams to prioritize and verify fixes that provide measurable operational improvements.
* Create and maintain clear test documentation including test plans test cases traceability matrices and execution reports that support audits and provide transparent evidence of validation coverage for all MES components.
* Provide mentoring and practical guidance to other test professionals on MES validation techniques automated testing practices and integration testing patterns fostering a culture of quality ownership across the delivery team.
* Engage in defect triage sessions and change review activities presenting well reasoned impact analyses and retest strategies that balance quality risk with project timelines for day shift hybrid operations.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance test automation frameworks test data management and environment stability thereby increasing efficiency across recurring MES validation cycles.
* Partner with manufacturing and supply chain stakeholders to understand process flows and key performance indicators ensuring that test scenarios reflect real operational conditions and help safeguard product quality and service reliability.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate extensive hands on experience in MES validation and automated testing with a proven track record of owning test design execution and reporting for complex enterprise scale implementations.
* Exhibit strong proficiency in manual MES validation activities including requirement analysis test case creation risk based prioritization and evidence collection suitable for regulated manufacturing environments.
* Show advanced skills in testing L4 L3 and L2 integration scenarios across planning manufacturing and shop floor systems with an ability to troubleshoot data flow discrepancies and interface failures effectively.
* Apply practical knowledge of generative AI in the context of software quality engineering using it to enhance test asset creation and analysis while maintaining strict review controls and compliance awareness.
* Demonstrate deep working knowledge of Camstar MES configuration object modeling and workflow behavior enabling precise validation of manufacturing processes and electronic records under varied operational conditions.
* Display solid understanding of manufacturing and supply chain business processes including work order management inventory tracking and quality events so that test coverage aligns with real world operational needs.
* Communicate findings and recommendations clearly in written and spoken form to cross functional teams enabling timely decisions on release readiness and risk mitigation in a hybrid day shift setting.
* Maintain strong analytical and problem solving capabilities supported by a methodical approach to root cause analysis that helps reduce recurring defects and enhances overall MES ecosystem stability.

title: Perception Autonomy Engineer
description:
**Career Area:**

Technology, Digital and Data

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition

Caterpillar’s Cat Technology team is seeking a Perception Developer to design, develop, and deploy perception software for autonomous and semi-autonomous machines used in construction. The role focuses on multi-sensor perception, computer vision, 3D point-cloud processing, sensor fusion, and production-quality software for safety-critical, resource-constrained platforms. The ideal candidate combines strong C++/Python development skills with hands-on experience building, optimizing, and validating perception algorithms from prototype through field deployment.

Responsibilities:

1. Design and implement perception algorithms for object and personnel detection, classification, segmentation, tracking, terrain understanding, localization, mapping, and obstacle assessment.

2. Develop camera, LiDAR, radar, GNSS, and IMU processing pipelines, including calibration, synchronization, sensor fusion, and uncertainty handling.

3. Translate research concepts and state-of-the-art models into robust, maintainable, production-quality C++ and Python software.

4. Optimize algorithms and neural-network inference for embedded CPU/GPU platforms using profiling, CUDA, TensorRT, and related acceleration technologies.

5. Build automated evaluation workflows, datasets, simulation scenarios, and test tools to measure accuracy, latency, robustness, and safety performance.

6. Debug and resolve perception issues using recorded data, simulation, hardware-in-the-loop systems, and field-machine testing.

7. Collaborate with systems, autonomy, controls, embedded software, validation, and safety teams to define interfaces and deliver integrated machine capabilities.

8. Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical documentation, and continuous improvement of software engineering practices.

Desired Qualifications:

1. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.

2. Strong programming skills in modern C++ and Python, with experience developing and debugging software on Linux.

3. Practical experience with computer vision, deep learning, 3D geometry, point-cloud processing, or robotic perception.

4. Experience with one or more perception tasks such as detection, segmentation, classification, tracking, localization, mapping, or sensor fusion.

5. Working knowledge of PyTorch or TensorFlow and common perception libraries such as OpenCV, PCL, Eigen, or similar tools.

6. Understanding of camera, LiDAR, radar, GNSS, and IMU sensor characteristics, calibration, coordinate systems, and data quality considerations.

7. Experience with ROS/ROS 2, DDS, Git, unit testing, continuous integration, and software documentation practices.

8. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills, with the ability to work across research and product-development teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

1. Experience deploying perception models on embedded or edge platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson, DRIVE, or comparable hardware.

2. Experience with CUDA, TensorRT, model quantization, profiling, and real-time performance optimization.

3. Knowledge of SLAM, visual or LiDAR odometry, Kalman filtering, probabilistic estimation, and graph-based spatial data structures.

4. Experience developing perception systems for autonomous vehicles, ADAS, mobile robots, mining, construction, or off-highway equipment.

5. Experience with simulation, synthetic data, dataset curation, annotation workflows, MLOps, or field validation.

6. Publications, patents, or demonstrated implementation of state-of-the-art perception methods are an advantage.

Be Part of What’s Next in Autonomous Construction Sites

Construction autonomy is one of the most complex challenges in applied AI, and at Caterpillar, advancements in physical AI, simulation, sensing, and edge computing are turning things that once felt impossible—intelligent machines operating in dynamic jobsites—into reality.

Our connected ecosystem brings together massive volumes [BH1.1][LR1.2]of high-quality data to create a foundation where engineers like you can build and deploy against.

If this work motivates you, we invite you to join our team. In these roles, you’ll work at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. You’ll help design and deliver intelligent systems that enable machines to perceive their environment, make informed decisions, and support safer, more productive operations.

Apply today to build the new era of construction autonomy at Caterpillar.

title: Design Engineer — PCB & Embedded Boards
description:
THE ROLE

We build industrial inspection systems — computer vision and AI retrofitted onto factory automation lines. The cameras, controllers, and I/O boards those systems run on are designed in house, and we are looking for the engineer who owns them.

This is not a supervised seat. You will take compact camera and embedded boards from block diagram through to a validated, manufacturable revision, and stay with them through bring-up, pilot builds, and the field issues that follow. Expect 4–8 layer boards, tight mechanical envelopes, and hardware that has to survive a shop floor.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

* Architecture and schematic capture for industrial camera and embedded compute boards — power tree, sensor interfaces, connectors, protection, and component selection you can defend.
* Multilayer PCB layout end to end: stackup and impedance planning, placement, routing of high-speed interfaces (MIPI CSI-2, USB, LVDS, Ethernet), power integrity, and EMI/thermal decisions.
* Design review discipline — ERC/DRC clean, DFM/DFA reviewed with the assembler, and manufacturing packages (Gerbers, drills, BOM, pick-and-place, assembly notes) released without rework loops.
* Board bring-up and validation: test plans, bench measurement, debugging with scope and analyzer, failure analysis, and revision notes that close the loop into the next spin
* Vendor and supply ownership — fabricators, assemblers, and distributors; second sources, lifecycle risk, and cost per board.
* Library and documentation standards in KiCad, plus mentoring one or two interns on layout and release hygiene

WHAT WE EXPECT

* 2–5 years designing production electronics; B.E./B.Tech in ECE, EEE, or equivalent practice.
* At least two boards you took from schematic to a manufactured, working revision — you can walk us through the mistakes and what the next spin fixed. Fluent in KiCad, or fluent in Altium/OrCAD and willing to move to KiCad as the house tool.
* Comfortable with datasheets, reference designs, and layout guidelines as primary sources; comfortable saying a design is not ready.
* Hands-on lab ability: soldering and rework, scope, DMM, logic analyzer, bring-up of an unpowered board you have never seen working.
* Written communication that survives handoff — schematics, notes, and reviews that another engineer can act on.

STRONG BONUS

* Image sensor integration, camera modules, or optics-adjacent hardware.
* SoM/SBC carrier design (NVIDIA Jetson, i.MX, Raspberry Pi CM) or FPGA-attached interfaces.
* Industrial I/O and field robustness — 24 V rails, isolation, surge and ESD, IP-rated enclosures.
* Firmware or driver literacy (C, embedded Linux device trees) enough to debug across the hardware boundary.
* Experience taking a board through EMC pre-compliance or a certification cycle.
* Mechanical CAD collaboration — STEP exchange, connector and mounting fit checks.

WHAT YOU GET

* Full ownership of the hardware line — your name on the boards, not on a subsection of someone else's.
* Short loop from design to deployment: our boards ship into live factory lines within months, not years.
* Prototyping budget, lab access, and no approval theatre for parts and spins you can justify.
* Flexible hours, and a small team where hardware sits in the room with the vision and firmware engineers.

HOW TO APPLY

Send a resume plus one page on a board you designed: what it did, the layout constraint that hurt most, and how you solved it. Gerbers, schematics, or photographs welcome — a portfolio beats a keyword list.

Process: portfolio screen → 60-minute technical conversation walking through your own design → a short take-home review of a real schematic → offer.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**Career Area:**


Technology, Digital and Data**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.


Build the Digital Backbone of Modern Manufacturing


We’re assembling a dynamic team to develop and scale our Manufacturing \& Supply Digital Platform—a next\-generation software framework that transforms how manufacturing and supply operations connect, collaborate, and optimize.


This platform is not an ERP system. It’s a purpose\-built digital layer that integrates data, processes, and resources across the entire manufacturing lifecycle—from design and engineering to production and distribution.


This initiative is powered by NVIDIA technologies, including the Omniverse platform and AI computing capabilities, enabling immersive digital twins, accelerated simulation, and intelligent automation. You’ll be part of a team that’s not just building software—but shaping the future of how manufacturing works through AI\-driven, collaborative, and scalable digital solutions.


As part of this initiative, you’ll contribute to:

* System Integration: Seamlessly connecting diverse manufacturing and supply systems, data sources, and workflows into a unified digital ecosystem.
* Data\-Driven Decision Making: Harnessing real\-time data collection, analysis, and visualization to deliver actionable insights and operational intelligence.
* Automation \& Optimization: Driving efficiency through intelligent scheduling, predictive maintenance, and quality control—without replacing core transactional systems.
* Enhanced Collaboration: Enabling transparent communication and coordination across teams, functions, and geographies.


If you're passionate about digital platforms, industrial innovation, and working with cutting\-edge technologies—this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead architectural design and development of generative/optimization models for process simulation, process scheduling, and predictive analytics in manufacturing.
* Orchestrate pipelines integrating synthetic data generation, model training, validation, and deployment.
* Implement advanced optimization: multi\-objective, non\-linear, evolutionary, and constraint\-based approaches for process efficiency (e.g., scheduling, logistics, yield predictions).
* Guide the integration of embedded AI \& Gen AI solutions with real\-time industrial data streams, ensuring high\-throughput, high\-availability, and low\-latency deployment.
* Mentor teams in coding best practices, simulation\-modelling, and deployment workflows using latest industrial AI stacks.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong experience with Generative AI models. Hands\-on experience with Amazon bedrock and AWS AI\-ML services
* Proficiency in building and managing Agentic AI systems using frameworks like LangChain, AutoGen or similar.
* Expertise on cloud\-native architecture, LLMOps and MLOps tools.
* Familiarity with security, cost and governance best practices for Gen AI on cloud environments.

**Nice to Have Skills:**

* Previous leadership in deploying ML pipelines and automation (CI/CD, containerization) at scale.
* Knowledge of quantization\-aware training, model pruning, and NVIDIA\-specific deployment tools (TensorRT, DeepStream SDK).
* Working knowledge of OpenUSD scene graphs, data schemas, and extension development for Omniverse Kit/Composer.
* Published research, open\-source contributions, or patents in simulation\-driven manufacturing AI or optimization.
* Familiarity with NVIDIA’s AI stack— RAPIDS, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT, cuOpt (or similar)
* Applied industrial AI expertise: root\-cause analysis, predictive maintenance, digital twin calibration.

**Educational Background:** Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree, preferably in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, mathematics, or a similar field with quantitative coursework, and 7\-10 years of professional experience in associated field is required, a Master’s degree and 4\-6 years of experience, or a PhD and 1\-3 years of experience in relevant field.


This position requires working onsite five days a week.
Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.**Posting Dates:**


September 16, 2026 \- October 1, 2026
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply
